fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Tegmine-sub-Fagi
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 核维吉尔《牧歌》第一首第1行：提提鲁斯在榉树下斜倚。Joyce 倒置 sub，组为拟地名。正文译榉荫乡，Titubante 保拟名，可另听蹒跚。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Anastashie
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 紧接「下一件展品」，又是 his Anastashie，展陈口气和亲近关系并列。中文保阿纳斯塔希音，不落实先前提出的各语词源。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Apagemonite
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 此词为驱斥呼声。Gordon 提出 Agapemones 线索，随后有勿近、黑、熄灯。教派与驱魔词如何压在一起未定，正文保原音。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Duke Humphrey
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 旧谚同汉弗莱公爵吃饭，意为没吃上饭。旧版《英国国家传记辞典》将俗语连到圣保罗座堂的步廊，并说明当地纪念碑误作公爵墓。Joyce 把 dine 改成 nunch，中文用「吃空午饭」。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Anne Lynch
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Mink 在406.27 将此名与 Lynch, Anne, and Co. 相连。Gordon 进一步读作都柏林茶店；此处尚未查到营业档案。原文呼名后接 Houseanna 与茶颂。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: St Jilian's
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 此名出现在食物、美酒与啤酒壶的连写中。圣徒身分及主保职能待核，原文未直接说明。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Hark! Tolv
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 此呼承399.29–30四名拖声与 Haw。Gordon 也连读两卷。卷首 Hark、Hork 各独行，保两次叫听。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Tolv two elf kater ten (it can't be) sax.
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 丹麦语 tolv 为十二，elf 可读十一，kater 近四的外语词形，sax 可听 six。译文夹音译和明数，保英语旁白，读秒次序不归一。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Pedwar pemp foify tray (it must be) twelve.
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 威尔士语 pedwar 为四，tri 为三；布列塔尼语 pemp 为五。foify 可听 five 或 forty 的变音，tray 近 tri。Gordon 兼读两方向的计数，本轮保错听，不重排。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: And low stole o'er the stillness the heartbeats of sleep.
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 主语心跳置于低声偷过静寂之后。Gordon 听作钟歇后显出的心音。中文先亮主语，保低声偷过。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: White fogbow spans. The arch embattled.
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 雾虹颜色本淡，英国气象局说明小水滴会使色带散开。Gordon 还并读《尤利西斯·喀耳刻》开场稀灯与淡虹。embattled 可带城垛和列阵感。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Mark as capsules.
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 可听作让人记下囊壳状物，Mark 也可能尚带上卷王名。1928年校样此处有 Mark has 和 captures 向 capsules 改的痕迹。所指器物待考。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: The nose of the man who was nought like the nasoes.
fw-iii1-403-01.text: nose、nought、nasoes 连响。Gordon 听出奥维德的姓 Naso；本句先留近音和不像的判断。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: selftinted, wrinkling, ruddled.
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 三词接鼻与脸的色、褶、赭红。Gordon 联想酒红鼻。译文保「自染」，不写饮酒因果。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: His kep is a gorsecone.
fw-iii1-403-01.text: kep 可听 cap，gorsecone 赋金雀花以锥状。Gordon 取尖帽；军衔无直接词证。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: whose fixtures are mobiling so wobiling befear my remembrandts.
fw-iii1-403-01.text: fixtures 本是固定物，却 mobiling、wobiling。Gordon 从 remembrandts 听见回忆与伦勃朗，正文缀作「伦勃忆」。befear 将面前与害怕并置。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: She has prayings in lowdelph.
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Gordon 在 lowdelph 听见低地荷兰语，也想到代尔夫特画派。正文兼保低、地名声形与念祷，具体礼仪待考。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Zeehere green eggbrooms.
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Zeehere 近 see here。Gordon 将 eggbrooms 读作 eyebrows；仍有卵、帚形。正文把绿眉、卵和帚捏在一处。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: What named blautoothdmand is yon who stares?
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 可从变形词读出蓝牙与男人。此处同时问名，是否用丹麦王哈拉尔蓝牙的称号，待考。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Gugurtha! Gugurtha!
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 近撒路斯特所写努米底亚王 Jugurtha，保首音改形和重名声。底本紧接喙和角皮，不能以历史传记代替这张脸。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: becco of wild hindigan. Ho, he hath hornhide!
fw-iii1-403-01.text: becco 可读作喙；Gordon 从 hindigan 同听 Hindu 与旧称 Indian，未落实单一地域。hornhide 叠角和皮，正文留形。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: And hvis now is for you.
fw-iii1-403-01.text: hvis 可听条件词，也可在北欧语形里读所有格疑问。眼下归谁之语意不定，正文保问声与对你，删旧稿所加轻语。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Pensée!
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 法语词可指念头和三色堇。Gordon 并读《哈姆雷特》第四幕第五场奥菲莉娅以花说思想，正文造「潘思花」，保读音与花、思。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: of the veilch veilchen veilde.
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 三次 veil 起声，可联面纱；德语 Veilchen 指紫罗兰。Gordon 兼听野地与 wild west。正文作帷、帷花、帷野，保三连。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: She would kidds to my voult of my palace, with obscidian luppas, her aal in her dhove's suckling.
fw-iii1-403-01.text: kidds 近吻，也可留幼物音。voult、obscidian、luppas 把穹窖、黑石、猥亵与口唇拧在一起。Gordon 连读396.31。aal 与 dhove 从鳗和鸽试读，句法仍待考。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Come not nere! Black! Switch out!
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 三次短令，和展品、画色同场，Gordon 读作舞台黑场。1928校样此处止于 Black，1939版多一声熄灯。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: somepart in nonland of where's please
fw-iii1-403-01.text: somepart 只给某处，nonland 随即撤地点，where’s please 又用问话。正文保某处、无地和劳驾。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: and it was when you and they were we
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 你与彼等是咱，换人称在同一刹那。1928年第四套校样本段没有这个括句，底本有，保括语。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: at zero hour as 'twere the peal of vixen's laughter
fw-iii1-403-01.text: peal 可用于笑声或钟声，两处合响。Gordon 把零点接回卷首错数，正文保零时与雌狐笑的并闻。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: midnight's chimes from out the belfry
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Gordon 连读《亨利四世》下篇第三幕第二场。福斯塔夫对夏洛说从前听过半夜钟声，原场接叙旧。此处保半夜与钟楼，直接用典仍属推断。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: tolling so faint a goodmantrue
fw-iii1-403-01.text: goodmantrue 紧跟敲钟，暂把好人、真听成钟的拟语。无实证坐定钟名或敲钟人的身份。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: nighthood's unseen violet rendered all animated greatbritish and Irish objects nonviewable
fw-iii1-403-01.text: unseen violet 可听紫外余义。Gordon 另读英国红与爱尔兰绿，正文不替夜里不可见诸物逐一定色。animated 取有生气，objects 保诸物。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: some glistery gleam darkling adown surface of affluvial flowandflow
fw-iii1-403-01.text: glistery gleam 与 darkling 让闪光暗下去，flowandflow 继续涌流。Gordon 从 affluvial 听出 effluent，正文保汇流与复流。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: garments of laundry reposing a leasward close at hand in full expectation
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Gordon 以衣物接回 I.8 河岸，又从 leasward 听出 leeward。lea 还可带草地。正文留歇衣、下风与期待，未把此处女子或河名写死。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: jogging along in a dream as dozing I was dawdling, arrah
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 梦中挪动与打盹磨蹭交叠，尾有语助 arrah。正文用颠走、盹与磨保速差。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: the creepers and the gliders and flivvers of the earth breath
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 依次爬、滑、突突奔。flivver 可牵旧式廉价汽车，正文留跑响。earth breath 将所列归到地息，避免都写成动物。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: the dancetongues of the woodfires and the hummers in their ground
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 火舌在跳，地底另有嗡响。Gordon 并读《画像》第二章斯蒂芬忆病房火光跳舞；对读仅证意象相近。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: vociferated echoating: Shaun! Shaun! Post the post!
fw-iii1-403-01.text: echoating 让齐呼又回荡。Post the post 重用一个字，兼动作与邮物。正文两次叫投邮，未另添邮差称号。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: the higher on high the deeper and low, I heard him so!
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 高上再高，低处又深。him 单数从齐呼转向肖恩，正文留第一人称听他的声。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: mescemed somewhat came of the noise and somewho might amove allmurk
fw-iii1-403-01.text: somewhat 转到 somewho。1928校样作 meseemed 与 among allmurk，底本作 mescemed，缺 among。正文保声中似出某物、某人动暗；不把显影坐成确定动作。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Now, 'twas as clump, now mayhap. When look, was light and now'twas as flasher, now moren as the glaow.
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 物先是团块，后看见光，闪后续辉。Gordon 兼听航标闪灯。校样尚作 more as the glow，中文留加亮和怪声，不提前点定光源。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: in unlitness 'twas in very similitude, bless me, 'twas his belted lamp!
fw-iii1-403-01.text: unlitness 可听不亮，也可如 Gordon 提出，听作小。similitude 承前似状，到 belted lamp 才辨腰灯。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Whom we dreamt was a shaddo, sure, he's lightseyes, the laddo!
fw-iii1-403-01.text: shaddo／laddo 同尾，lightseyes 又近 life-size。Gordon 据此读出物影渐成人身，正文保影、亮眼与等身。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Blessed momence, O romence, he's growing to stay!
fw-iii1-403-01.text: momence／romence 同拍，可听时刻、传奇，也如 Gordon 所指可听 moments、O Romans。正文保增长与留下，未断定呼罗马人。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: so swayed a will of a wisp before me
fw-iii1-403-01.text: will of a wisp 变动 will-o’-the-wisp。Gordon 又听见一小缕；鬼火般晃动承前腰灯初现。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: hand prop to hand, prompt side to the pros
fw-iii1-403-01.text: hand、prop、prompt side 缀手持道具与剧场提词边，pros 又近台口词形；读「手边」也可。1928校样这一接续未见。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: a classy mac Frieze o'coat of far suparior ruggedness
fw-iii1-403-01.text: mac 可作雨衣名，Frieze 接粗呢外套，suparior 坏了拼写仍夸比同类更耐磨。中文保麦克音和粗呢。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: indigo braw, tracked and tramped
fw-iii1-403-01.text: braw 又响398.34报钱的苏格兰语声。tracked／tramped 连路与足踏。Gordon 同时猜这些痕迹也像桶板。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: an Irish ferrier collar, freeswinging with mereswin lacers from his shoulthern
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Gordon 从 ferrier 听铁工与 tarrier。mereswin 可听海猪，lacers 近带绳，shoulthern 将肩和南缀起。材料、装饰用途待考。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: thick welted brogues on him hammered to suit the scotsmost public and climate
fw-iii1-403-01.text: welted 指鞋沿接条。hammered 接敲鞋，scotsmost 联 Scottish 与 Scotch mist。brogue 还可指口音，正文按鞋名。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: iron heels and sparable soles
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 约克郡历史词典记 sparable 为无头楔形小铁钉。鞋跟的铁与鞋底楔钉并列，旧稿所写平头有所误。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: jacket of providence wellprovided woolies with a softrolling lisp of a lapel
fw-iii1-403-01.text: providence／provided 把神意与衣料供应扣在一起。软卷翻领带 lisp，衣服拟人口齿。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: great sealingwax buttons, a good helping bigger than the slots for them
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 封信用蜡、纽扣及扣眼相叠，Gordon 又听见投信口与一大份食物。正文保封蜡扣和份量。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: twentytwo carrot krasnapoppsky red
fw-iii1-403-01.text: carrot 与 carat 同音，橙红与贵重相缠，保二十二。拟俄语形 krasnapoppsky 和红相近，确切语源待考。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: invulnerable burlap whiskcoat and his popular choker
fw-iii1-403-01.text: whiskcoat 近 waistcoat，亦带鬚声。Gordon 将麻布外罩与箍领连到桶罩、桶箍。正文先留衣料与颈箍。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Tamagnum sette-and-forte
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 介于箍领和声大玩物之间，Gordon 连读403.09榉荫拟名。具体名字与数字串未定，正文保音。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: his loud boheem toy
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Gordon 转引 McHugh 联系《波希米亚人》的玩具小贩。读剧本第二幕，帕尔皮尼奥尔确叫卖玩具。toy 亦可用于衣饰，译文保玩具结。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: a starspangled zephyr with a decidedly surpliced crinklydoodle front
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 星斑轻织物接祭衣褶襟，crinklydoodle 可听褶皱与 Yankee Doodle。中文留褶、祭衣和嘟嘟声。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: his motto through dear life embrothred over it in peas, rice, and yeggyyolk
fw-iii1-403-01.text: embrothred 近刺绣又嵌 broth。豌豆、米粒和蛋黄既成纹饰又像食迹。正文用汤绣保两读。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Or for royal, Am for Mail, R.M.D. hard cash on the nail
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 1928校样尚直书 R 与 M，底本成 Or 与 Am。Gordon 又听出欧米伽到阿尔法。保三字母和现钱当场付，D 所扩待考。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: gigot turnups now you ever, (what a pairfact crease! how amsolookly kersse!)
fw-iii1-403-01.text: gigot 是羊腿，也是服装形制词。大都会馆藏说明用于膨袖，本句则移到裤脚。pairfact 近 perfect 又是两腿成对。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: may the turtle's blessings of God and Mary and Haggispatrick and Huggisbrigid be souptumbling all over him!
fw-iii1-403-01.text: turtle 可引斑鸠与龟汤，圣名又拌羊杂、拥抱、滚汤和踉跄。正文用拟名并保整段倾泻的祝愿。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: his hundred thousand welcome stewed letters, relayed wand postchased, multiply, ay faith, and plultiply!
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 数量是十万，信件一程接一程，夹杖与追邮、信与信仰。plultiply 又多一拍。1928校样未见 wand 这层。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: What a picture primitive!
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 肖恩名字迟至两道括语后才出现。图画叹句另行，primitive 殿后，正文另起短叹。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: the concordant wiseheads of Messrs Gregory and Lyons alongside of Dr Tarpey's and I dorsay the reverend Mr Mac Dougall's
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 四人轮列。concordant 带和声，先跟下句四声部相应。dorsay 像 daresay，插在第三、第四名之间，中文保「我敢说」。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: I, poor ass, am but as their fourpart tinckler's dunkey
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Gordon 并读阿普列尤斯《金驴记》。第三卷末琉喀乌斯误变驴，仍自知其形。本段自嘲以驴随四声部，具体叮当声源待考。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: holy messonger angels be uninterruptedly nudging him among and along the winding ways of random ever!
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Gordon 从驴、路与天使联到《民数记》22.21–33。经文先由驴看见拦路使者，再由巴兰看见。小说中使者推肖恩走，动作有别。messonger 兼可听信使与法语梦。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Shaun in proper person
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 祷语把两次 Shaun 隔开，随后又夹星空祝词，最后才落到站在面前。正文保两唤与插话位置。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: the blueblacksliding constellations continue to shape his changeable timetable!
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 蓝黑、滑动与群星连成变化的计时表，应卷首错时和肖恩邮差身份。Gordon 提到可用星象计时，正文保动态。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: I pledge you my agricultural word
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 正式担保词加农家声口，紧接眉眼又有视觉计数。正文取庄稼人作保证，省去旧稿二次起誓。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: the hundred and sixty odds rods and cones of this even's vision
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 一百六十有零，odds 又撞上 even’s。even 也能指傍晚。Gordon 转述笔记作160,000，JJDA 直指 VI.B.20 的转录当前未公开。中文依底本保少量与夜视，数字不作生理测量。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: the Bel of Beaus' Walk, a prime card if ever was!
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Gordon 听出 beaux／belles 的角色互换，另听伦敦 Bow Bells。card 可夸人出色并带牌，正文用「美男巷一朵美人花」「头牌好牌」。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Pep? Now without deceit
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 先问劲头，立刻转诚实夸张语。Gordon 读作自问自答，不是人名。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: so fired smart, in much more than his usual health
fw-iii1-403-01.text: fired 与气色俏劲同现。Gordon 又联到熏烧酒桶，局部只见夸人，正文保火声。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: No mistaking that beamish brow!
fw-iii1-403-01.text: beamish 和 brow 起首双响。额头接前夜光，正文以焕亮串回眼见。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: aight through the months without a sign of an err in hem
fw-iii1-403-01.text: aight 使 ate、eight 挨近，err 可读错与字母 R。Gordon 以吃牡蛎俗说联到八个带 R 的月份，原句偏说不见 R，正文保矛盾。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: otherwise rounding, fourale to the lees of Traroe.
fw-iii1-403-01.text: rounding 可指转向也可指吃圆。Gordon 以 four 接八成十二，又听 fall to；ale 与 lees 给酒和酒脚。Traroe 指涉待考。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Those jehovial oyeglances!
fw-iii1-403-01.text: jehovial 叠耶和华和欢快，oyeglances 又有眼光与眼镜。Gordon 由 Joyce 笔记线索指向弗洛伊德所引施雷伯；文章索引摘文见耶和华光线，尚未核到影印页。此处是否直接取文仍待考。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: The heart of the rool! And hit the hencoop.
fw-iii1-403-01.text: rool 可听 roll 或 rule，Gordon 另提欧凯西台词，本轮未核剧本原句。后句可听鸡笼及制桶者音，正文保卷与鸡笼，留动作突转。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: He was immense, topping swell
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Gordon 将三词也听成连声叫好。swell 兼膨胀与神气，中文保体态、赞语同出。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: a twentyfour hours every moment matters maltsight
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 二十四小时分分刻刻皆有事；moment、matters、maltsight 三起 m，麦芽接下句店名。1928校样未见这一截。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: in a porterhouse, scutfrank
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Gordon 并读啤酒店和 porterhouse 牛排，scutfrank 听作 scot-free，在此可指不收费。中文保酒与肉胃口，暂不坐实店址。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Saint Lawzenge of Toole's, the Wheel of Fortune
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 基督教会座堂史载都柏林大主教 Laurence O’Toole。Saint Lawzenge of Toole’s 改拆音名，又像 lozenge。1928校样已有前名，未见命运之轮。两招牌关系待考。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: leave your clubs in the hall and wait on yourself
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 是店规口吻，clubs 可指棍杖，也可在后文红心旁听作牌色。wait on yourself 指自己照料，不添服务员。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: no chucks for walnut ketchups, Lazenby's and Chutney graspis
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Beeton 1861年食谱第535–536条用胡桃或胡桃壳做 ketchup。1870年《The Examiner》广告证 Lazenby 家卖调味品，广告所列 Harvey’s Sauce 不等于此处胡桃汁。graspis 近 gratis 又似抓取，正文保白拿。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: the once queen of Bristol and Balrothery twice admired
fw-iii1-403-01.text: once／twice 一前一后，分别落在女王称号和赞许次数。正文复那个「一度／两度」，未指定历史女王。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: her frumped door looked up Dacent Street
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 门像衣旧相老的人，向上看体面街。Dacent 近 decent 的变音，译名保拟意。Gordon 联系女王形象，实际街址未定。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: in the sighed of lovely eyes while his knives of hearts made havoc
fw-iii1-403-01.text: sighed 与 sight 相响，knives 与红心侍从 knave 交叠。Gordon 并读《尤利西斯·卡吕普索》里布卢姆爱烤心，核见原段。中文留目光、叹息、刀和牌形，互文仍属近读。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: meals of spadefuls of mounded food
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 食物堆起，再以铲为份。spade 也可响黑桃，承前红心。正文用满铲与堆食，牌义留注。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: in anticipation of the faste of tablenapkins
fw-iii1-403-01.text: faste 可近 fast、feast、fête。餐巾预备开餐，又像开斋、节日。底本有这截，校样暂无，中文合为「开斋节」。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: threepartite pranzipal meals plus a collation
fw-iii1-403-01.text: pranzipal 把正餐、进食声拧在 principal 里。collation 是另添小食。正文保三顿与一顿加餐，未擅定加餐时段。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: a bless us O blood and thirsthy orange
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 开吃先听餐祷，O blood 又可听血型，血与橙也可合成血橙。thirsthy 带口渴，中文保「O 血渴橙」。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: the half of a pint of becon with newled googs
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 量词偏用半品脱，becon 近 bacon，newled googs 听新下的蛋。煎法未交代，量词未改成重量。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: a segment of riceplummy padding, met of sunder suigar
fw-iii1-403-01.text: padding 近 pudding，保填垫余声。riceplummy 听米与梅干，suigar 近糖，具体糖种待考。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: cold forsoaken steak peatrefired from the batblack night o'erflown
fw-iii1-403-01.text: forsoaken 叠受冷落与浸泡，peatrefired 叠泥炭复烤与石化。Gordon 提醒 then 前可读停顿。正文在飞逝蝠黑之后换段，午餐另起。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: without prejuice to evectuals
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 套 without prejudice to 的句式，prejuice 又显出 juice；evectuals 可按 victuals 读。紧接飞逝蝠夜，Gordon 建议 then 前留停顿。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: of a half a pound or round steak
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Faded Page 此处作 or，JJDA 所示1939年版和1928年第四套校样作 of。菜单语势仍容半磅牛后腿排，译用「呃」留下接缝。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: riceypeasy and Corkshire alla mellonge
fw-iii1-403-01.text: rice 与 peas 跟着早餐米饭换菜，riceypeasy 还可听作 easy-peasy。Corkshire 将 Cork 与郡名词尾并写，mellonge 在杂烩上下文可听 mélangé。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: proprietoress of the roastery
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 字面是烤肉店女主人。Gordon 听出 prioress of the Rosary（玫瑰经修院院长）近音。具体修院待考。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: gaulusch gravy and pumpernickel to wolp up
fw-iii1-403-01.text: gaulusch 近 goulash，pumpernickel 是深色粗黑麦面包。wolp 在进食语境听作 wolf 或 gulp，译作大嚼。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Appelredt's or Kitzy Braten's
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Mink 在406.09 对 Appelredt 留疑，另将 Kitzy Braten 与瑞士德语 Gitzibraten（烤小山羊肉）相联系。拟店名中藏菜名，店址待考。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: a Botherhim with her old phoenix portar
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 1928年第四套校样在此作 Botherham。正文用 Botherhim，可连听 bother him 与火腿夹，her 紧跟其后；Mink 将 phoenix portar 联系凤凰啤酒厂。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: praties sweet and Irish too
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Gordon 分读甜薯与爱尔兰马铃薯。两种薯类并列，译文各列一项。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: mock gurgle to whistle his way through for the swallying, swp by swp
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Gordon 从 mock gurgle 听见假龟汤及喝汤咕噜，swp 抽去元音，吞咽声又急又短；译用两声「啜」。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Boland's broth broken into the bargain
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Mink 录 Boland’s Ltd。Gordon 由 broken 与德语 Brot（面包）读出掰面包入汤；译文采用此读，保留汤。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: pepper the diamond bone hotted up timmtomm
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 《都柏林人·死者》将钻石骨西冷、三先令茶和瓶装黑啤相连。这里亦见牛排、钻石骨、茶和啤酒。胡椒与骨名在此可有不同分读，译文列开。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: in their green free state a clister of peas, soppositorily petty, last.
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Mink 连爱尔兰自由邦；Gordon 听出 peas／pee、clister／clyster 与 soppositorily／suppository。译以「绿邦」「注」「豆塞」留政治及身体两层。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: a fingerhot of rheingenever
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Mink 将 fingerhot 与德语 Fingerhut（顶针）相连，也读出一顶针份净杜松酒。Gordon 重 hot 烧喉感。译并小盅与烧喉，保留莱茵一读。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Pax cum Spiritututu. Drily thankful.
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 弥撒平安礼以 Pax 起句，应词有 Et cum spiritu tuo。原文把平安与应词揉合，吞吐三个 tu 音。Gordon 又将 Drily thankful 连到餐祷，dry 兼酒味。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: loaves are aflowering and the nachtingale jugs
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Gordon 读 loaves 的面包并听见 leaves、loves，aflowering 连 flour 与 flower，nachtigall 是德语夜莺；jugs 还留酒壶。译取面粉、花、鸟声与壶。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Mabhrodaphne, brown pride of our custard house quay
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Mavrodaphne 意为黑月桂，是希腊酿酒葡萄名。Mink 将 custard house quay 读作都柏林 Custom House Quay。拟写在酒色和奶馅之间转声，译文保留两种名称的痕迹。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Ever of thee, Anne Lynch, he's deeply draiming!
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Hall 作曲、Linley 作词的歌曲以 Ever of thee 起首，后接 dreaming。Gordon 又从 thee 听法语 thé（茶），从 draiming 读 dream 与 drain。译用梦深与饮尽两路。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: For auld lang Ayternitay!
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 改《Auld Lang Syne》副歌，Ayternitay 添入 eternity，尾音又接前句 Tea。译用「旧日长久永恒茶」，让祝酒曲落回茶杯。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: And better and better on butterand butter.
fw-iii1-403-01.text: better 紧贴 butter，声音越念越肥。Faded Page 将首个 butter 与 and 连写，JJDA 1939 分写。译用黄油连黄油和两叠越吃越好。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Mesthress Vanhungrig
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Mesthress 近 mistress，hungrig 有饥饿一层。Mink 同列匈牙利及 Vanhomrigh 住宅两条线索；正文先取女掌柜招牌与饥饿声。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: make the ingestion
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 句法可还原为 make the suggestion；ingestion 把「提出」染成「摄入」。译用「吞吐」将舌头留在饭桌和话头之间。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: menuly some ham and jaffas
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 火腿与雅法橙在菜单上。Gordon 转述 McHugh 的近音读法：some、ham、jaffas 连听谢姆、含和雅弗。人名线索入注，正文保留菜名。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: thermidor oogst or floreal may while the whistling prairial roysters play
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 法国共和历热月、花月、牧月分跨公历七至八月、四至五月、五至六月。原句把历名与月份并排，牧月又冒出吹哨者；Gordon 从 roysters 听出 roisterers 与 oysters。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: deah smorregos
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Gordon 引 Christiani，连读瑞典语 smörgås（敞口三明治）与 gosse（男孩）；两逗号又留出称呼读者的位置。译作「亲爱的三明治小子」。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: a bottle of ardilaun
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Mink 在407.04 联系 Ardilaun 与健力士酒厂。爱尔兰传记辞典载阿瑟·爱德华·健力士封 Ardilaun 男爵并曾掌酒厂。正文保留瓶中物借人名的说法，品牌读入注。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: his net intrants wight weighed nought but a flyblow to his gross and ganz afterduepoise
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 净入口与餐后整副毛重相对，ganz 添一个德语「全」；flyblow 带一星半点，也可见蝇卵和污点。译保留苍蝇与称重用语。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: a romp of a schoolgirl's completion
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 所用见证及 JJDA 1939 作 completion。Gordon 从中听 complexion，另提示另版词形。译用「成色」贴近脸色，也留下成形义。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Overture and beginners!
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 序曲与剧场催首批演员就位的喊声。译为两声短号令，接下文肖恩开嗓。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: mesaw mestreamed, as the green to the gred was flew, was flown, through deafths of durkness greengrown deeper
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Gordon 将 mestreamed 听作 meseemed，将 deafths 听作 depths，词形又露出 stream 与 deaf。保留看见、流动、聋深三层；gred 的红读暂取，未坐实颜色变化所指。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: a voice, the voce of Shaun, vote of the Irish, voise from afar
fw-iii1-403-01.text: voice、voce、vote、voise 四次挪音。voce 显出意大利语嗓音，vote 带表决，Gordon 从 voise 叠读 voice 与 noise。中文以声字串起四次回响。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: puer palestrine e'er chanted panangelical mid the clouds of Tu es Petrus
fw-iii1-403-01.text: DIAMM 曲录列帕莱斯特里那六声部《你是伯多禄》。词形容纯童声与全体天使合唱，未见特指某位歌童的证据。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: rawsucked frish uov in urinal
fw-iii1-403-01.text: rawsucked 与 frish 连读「生吸鲜蛋」；uov 近意大利语鸡蛋词。urinal 把歌剧嗓门从云间扯回小便池，译文保留具体地点。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: a brieze to Yverzone o'er the brozaozaozing sea
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Gordon 连 breeze 与 ozone，又由 Y 联想伊瑟；Mink 另列威尔士语爱尔兰名 Iwerddon。正文音译受话方，保留海风带臭氧的读法。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: to scented nightlife
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Gordon 连《尤利西斯·瑙西卡》：布卢姆闻到香水，继而琢磨传播与导体。此处香气与无线电并行，可作跨文本对读。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: marconimasts from Clifden sough open tireless secrets (mauveport! mauveport!) to Nova Scotia's listing sisterwands
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 马可尼1909年诺奖演讲印页213记爱尔兰克利夫登和加拿大格莱斯湾两站于1907年10月开通商业通信。新斯科舍档案亦藏两站首通商用新闻电文当天的收报室照片。译留桅杆、侧耳及两迭呼号。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: His handpalm lifted, his handshell cupped, his handsign pointed, his handheart mated, his handaxe risen, his handleaf fallen.
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 六个 hand- 连续领动作：掌、壳、标、心、斧、叶。译文逐项保留「手」；下文用手承接说话。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Helpsome hand that holemost heals!
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Gordon 叠读 heals、whole、almost。译成「差点全治好」，保留求全和未全同在。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Alo, alass, aladdin, amobus!
fw-iii1-403-01.text: 哈喽、叹声、阿拉丁与阿莫布斯同押 a 起头。Gordon 从 amo 听见拉丁语初习变位。正文留拟名和试口节拍，阿莫布斯所指待考。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Does she lag soft fall means rest down?
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Gordon 读出唱名；开头 Does she lag 可听 do–si–la，soft fall means 又露 sol–fa–mi 近音。保留开三个唱名与软落歇息问句。第四套校样措辞和句末标点均有异。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: as his general address rehearsal
fw-iii1-403-01.text: address 是演说，也是邮递所向的地址，rehearsal 指排练。Gordon 转述 address rehearsal／dress rehearsal 的双读；肖恩先呵欠试声。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: antepropreviousday's pigeons-in-a-pie with rough dough for the carrier
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Gordon 将 antepropreviousday 读作大前天。多层时间词缀译作「大大前天」，并保留鸽肉馅派、粗面与信差。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: hash-say-ugh of overgestern
fw-iii1-403-01.text: hash 带杂烩，结尾 ugh 带反胃声；overgestern 近德语 vorgestern（前天）。「前昨儿」及「哈咻呃」兼顾日期与试声。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: 'stuesday's shampain in his head
fw-iii1-403-01.text: shampain 听作 champagne，也显出 sham；Gordon 又疑有法语 pain（面包）。正文取假香槟，’stuesday 的截断音未另译。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: hicnuncs of the present embelliching
fw-iii1-403-01.text: hic 与 nunc 可读「此地」「此刻」，hic 又像打嗝，embelliching 叠 embellishing 与 belch。中文让嗝声既缀饰曲子又打断它。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: Miccheruni's band
fw-iii1-403-01.text: ITMA 目录列歌词《Mickey Rooney’s Band》，署 Mitchell 与 Feeney；JJON 另考早期舞台歌曲及1913年拉格泰姆近题曲。译文保留改形人名，注出曲名线索，未定乔伊斯所用本。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: the rag was up and of the briefs and billpasses, a houseful of deadheads
fw-iii1-403-01.text: rag 可听作旗布或幕布；Gordon 比《尤利西斯》第九章开戏前剧场升旗。passes 与整屋白看戏的相应。票证上 bill 的广告、节目单或账单一层仍待考。

fw-iii1-403-01.lemma: to dye his paddycoats to morn his hesternmost
fw-iii1-403-01.text: Paddy 带爱尔兰人之称，paddycoats 又近 petticoats；dye／die 与 morn／mourn 同音。hesternmost 跨页接 408.01 earning，译文延后落句。原文无颜色，衣色不补。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Saint Anthony Guide
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Franciscan Media 方济各会文章记信封、封口下或邮票旁写 S.A.G. 的祈护习俗，释作 Saint Anthony Guide 或 Guard。本句在邮差问答前借作呼告。尚未核到小说成稿年代的信封实物。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Solvitur palumballando
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Carroll 1895年《乌龟对阿基里斯说了什么》见格言 solvitur ambulando。Lewis 与 Short 释 ambulo 为行走、palumbes 为林鸽。拟词可把鸽脚移入行走解题，亦回照鸽派和科伦巴。译作「鸽步而解」，尚无证据确定乔伊斯经由 Carroll 取此格言。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Pantokreator
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 句中称神并按使徒书鞭宣誓；词形可听 Pantokrator（全能者）、creator（造主）及肉食语感。译作「全能肉造主」。Gordon 读邻句宣誓为身体戏语，复合词成分仍属推测。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Buccinate in Emenia
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 《武加大》诗篇80.4（通行编号81）以 Buccinate in neomenia tuba 开头，接节期。Emenia 可连 Emain Macha；volumnitatis 又把节期字形挪向卷帙、声量。Gordon 同时想到 Purcell，Purcell 的 Blow up the trumpet in Sion 曲谱用的是另一句经文。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Nolaner and Browno
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 二名列在 my publickers 之后，可读作出版者名。布鲁诺及书商双指尚待具名来源，不据此断言乔伊斯思想渊源。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Tighe
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 三声 high 接邮差调台口令。Gordon 将 Tighe 与诗人一义相联。正文保留老泰伊，具体人物及词源待核。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: earning, his board in the swealth of his fate
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Faded Page 与 JJDA 1939 在 earning 后有逗号；1928年第四套校样无此逗号。earning 接上页 hesternmost，board 可指膳食；swealth 显出 sweat 与 wealth。译以工钱及饭钱相承，留下汗财叠义。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: moistened his manducators upon the quiet
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 先偷偷润湿咀嚼器官，再用两根食指清理牙齿。校样作 mandibles（下颌），通行本文换成 manducators；中文取「润润嘴」，不另指定肌肉。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: he sank his hunk, dowanouet to resk at once
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 校样语势近 sank down to reszk。正文添 hunk 与拖腔，译用一身肉沉下和两声「歇」。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: the combined weight of his tons of iosals was a hundred men's massed too much for him
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 校样只说合重难负，正文加 tons、iosals 与百人体重。依合重逾百人修订译文，iosals 暂音译，未定它指自我、重量或所负之物。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: who who e'er trod sod of Erin could ever sleep off the turf!
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Gordon 一读离开爱尔兰便睡不着，另一读睡也睡不掉草土或泥炭烟。译保留两声「谁」，以「离了草土睡」留第一层，第二层入注。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: I'm liberally dished seeing myself in this trim!
fw-iii1-408-01.text: dished 让「吃得丰盛」与「给整惨了」相撞。Gordon 读体形为一盘盘吃出来；第四套校样作 literally，正文则作 liberally。译为丰盘害惨了，保留席面及自嘲。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: How all too unwordy am I, a mere mailman of peace
fw-iii1-408-01.text: unwordy 是无话或不会说话，又贴近 unworthy（一句自谦）。mailman 连 male／man，peace 是所送也似祝语。用「不成话」「送信求平安」保留几层声义。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: the principot of Candia, no legs and a tide
fw-iii1-408-01.text: principot 叠头领声与 pot 的容器形；Candia 暂留地名音。Faded Page 作 tide，JJDA 1939 和1928年第四套校样作 title。译文以潮头接下文高位，头衔及酒桶联想入注。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: bearer extraordinary of these postoomany missive
fw-iii1-408-01.text: postoomany 可读邮递、太多与 posthumous（身后）；Gordon 亦读送信者抱怨信多压身。译取「这许多迟到的身后信」，不指认某封信。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: me and yous and them we're extending us after the pattern of reposiveness!
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 代词在短句里轮番冒出，复数 yous 又带口语。reposiveness 随身体伸展听作 repose，译用「我呀你呀他呀」，保留搭话节拍。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: the mightif beam maircanny, which bit his mirth too early or met his birth too late!
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Gordon 兼读 might-have-been、马可尼电波与 canny，接407页无线电。后句把 mirth／birth 及前后时间掉换。译取「本可辉煌」与电波，保留咬中欢笑、撞上出世。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: my other with his leickname for he's the head and I'm an everdevoting fiend of his.
fw-iii1-408-01.text: leickname 近 nickname，fiend 少 friend 的 r，却仍贴着「永远倾心」。译以「冤友」兼亲近与怨意；原句交代谁是头，未交代受审或共犯。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: seeze tomirror in tosdays of yer
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Gordon 从 seeze 听 see 与 seize，从 tomirror 听 tomorrow 并见 mirror。tosdays of yer 似今日、往日或周二交错。译让镜里明日回照往年今日。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: sembal simon pumpkel pieman yers
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Halliwell 所辑童谣写傻西蒙遇见卖馅饼的人，正文在 Simon 与 pieman 间添 pumpkel。sembal 的相像声也承下句孪生房间。译取傻西蒙、南瓜派与相像。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: what Sim sobs todie I'll reeve tomorry
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Gordon 汇列说／抽泣与播种、读／梦与收割两组。译让「呜咽播下」连「收来入梦」，留今日、明日相折，todie 的死音交代在此。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Sam Dizzier's feedst
fw-iii1-408-01.text: feedst 叠 feed 与 feast。Mink 将拟名同法国 Saint-Dizier 相联；Gordon 另联 Isidore。正文沿拟名作宴，神名、节日与日期待核。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: I'm thine owelglass. Be old!
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Folger 目录收 MacKenzie 的英语《Tyll Owlglass》，对应蒂尔·欧伦施皮格尔。镜字回扣 tomirror；Be old 又近 behold。翻译以「瞧，老去吧」及猫头鹰镜并存。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Fish hands Macsorley! Elien! Obsequies! Bonzeye! Isaac Egari's Ass!
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 五声呼号催快节拍；Fish hands 留鱼与手，Obsequies 是葬仪，Bonzeye 或可听到万岁与眼音，余名暂循拟音。鱼手一声未见送鱼动作。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: swimmyease bladdhers at the Guinness gala in Badeniveagh
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Gordon 听游泳浮囊、游泳者与连体兄弟，Mink 把 Badeniveagh 连到 Iveagh 公共浴场。Iveagh Trust 载当地确有游泳庆会及现场乐队；本场获奖属于书中叙述。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: he' such a game loser! I lift my disk to him.
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 底本 he’ 留截音，JJDA 1939 作 he’s；game 可说输得起，也可直指输掉比赛。Gordon 兼读举帽与啤酒桶圆盖，译作「帽盘」。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Brass and reeds, brace and ready!
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Brass／brace、reeds／ready 两对贴音，把铜管簧管转成就绪号令。译用「铜管簧管，绷紧备响」接舞台声。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: How is your napper, Handy, and hownow does she stand?
fw-iii1-408-01.text: napper 可指脑袋，hownow 把问候挤成一声。校样作 Andy，正文作 Handy；Gordon 对读《尤利西斯·喀耳刻》的 Handy Andy。她所指仍悬着。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: the eldest daughter she was panseying
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 可顺作「大女儿在想什么」，panseying 又显 pansy 的花形。正文将三色堇塞回问句，保留摸清想法一层。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: old Madre Patriack
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Madre 称母，Patriack 贴近 patriarch，又可听 Patrick。译用母父及帕特里亚克，保留两种称谓相撞，人物未定。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Take this John's Lane in your toastingfourch.
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Powers 厂史确认都柏林约翰巷酒厂，未限定书中酒款。旧俗语 toasting-fork 兼长柄烤叉与剑；句中还可听见举杯祝酒。译留酒、烤叉与敬酒声。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Shaunti and shaunti and shaunti again!
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 《荒原》末尾三次念 shantih，艾略特原注释为奥义书末所祷求的平安。Gordon 对读此处；改形又现 Shaun，译用三声「肖安」兼名与祝祷。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: twelve coolinder moons
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 第四套校样作 colander，正文 coolinder 可留凉意，并靠近 calendar。十二轮月保留历数，凉筛保留字形改动与漏筛。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: I am no helotwashipper but I revere her! For my own coant!
fw-iii1-408-01.text: helotwashipper 可听作 helot worshipper 与 wash；coant 旁有 own，可听 on my own account，也容粗口叠音。译保留崇拜与敬重的区别，粗口一读未定。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Piscisvendolor!
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 拟拉丁词可拆出 piscis（鱼）、vend-（卖）及 dolor（痛）。正文凝成短呼，避免指定未见于词形的人物性别。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Futs dronk of Wouldndom!
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Gordon 转述 McHugh 所读 first duke of Wellington，另听醉音并提出别线。正文取最先、爵位与醉声，保留地名扭转。此呼喊跨408、409页。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: the man Shee shinging in the pantry bay
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 校样作 banshee singing；通行文字添 man、将唱字写为 shinging，留下报丧妖性别反转及嘶声。pantry bay 译为「食橱湾」，保留屋内与水边的重叠。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Down among the dustbins let him lie!
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Bantock 编曲谱印页51可见《Down Among the Dead Men》副歌。这里死者换成垃圾桶，保留 down、among 与 let him lie 的句架。译保留往下和躺着。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Ear! Ear! Not ay! Eye! Eye!
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 耳和眼的短喊交替，Ear 近 hear，ay 似应声又接 eye。校样写 aye。译用「耳／嗳／眼」留下换声和肯否。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: on my solemn merits as a recitativer
fw-iii1-408-01.text: recitativer 近朗诵者，也带歌剧宣叙调。肖恩搬出身分作郑重自证，译称「宣叙伶人」。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Not the phost of a nation! Nor by a long trollop!
fw-iii1-408-01.text: phost／nation 疑改自 ghost of a notion，前词又显 post。下句像 not by a long chalk 一类彻底否认，又塞入 trollop 的泼妇或荡妇声。译作「国邮幽念」和「一大婆脚」，试留词错位。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: who out of symphony gave you the permit?
fw-iii1-408-01.text: symphony 留同声、合乐一层，近 sympathy 却仍写作 symphony。上文方有管簧，后接肖恩歌调。正文以「同声相应」保存音乐转场，发证者未点名。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: with a voice pure as a churchmode, in echo rightdainty
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 教会调式与回音先定音色。1928年第四套校样只有回音一层；定稿才添教会调式。译文分开音质与回响。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: catlick tug at his cocomoss candylock
fw-iii1-408-01.text: catlick 兼听 cat lick 与 Catholic，扯鬈发动作也有舔理意味。译取猫舐，教会调式已经邻接宗教音。椰苔糖鬈暂依词形。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: his cabbageous brain's curlyflower
fw-iii1-408-01.text: cabbageous 给脑袋添甘蓝，curlyflower 兼鬈发、花与 cauliflower；译用鬈花菜延续卷发与甘蓝。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Athiacaro! Comb his tar odd gee sing your mower O meeow? Greet thee Good?
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Gordon 将长问读作逐渐升高的练声。译保留前半试口音，以及 mower／meeow 的呼唤与猫声；Athiacaro 的地名、语言叠音暂待核。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: How are them columbuses! Lard have mustard on them!
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Gordon 一读鸽派与猪油芥末，一读脚茧与芥末浴；Lord have mercy 的祷句也粘连 lard／mustard。鸽伦布保留 Columbus 的字形痕，脚茧一读入注。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Hobos hornknees and the corveeture of my spine. Poumeerme!
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 硬膝与脊梁弯接疲倦，corveeture 在 curvature 之外似叠法语 corvée（苦役）；Poumeerme 又近 poor me。译以又弯又苦接自怜。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: My heaviest crux and dairy lot it is
fw-iii1-408-01.text: crux 是十字与难处；dairy 把跑邮差和清早送奶并照。Gordon 同时听见担十字架，未定这些动作逐一对应苦路。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: with a bed as hard as the thinkamuddles of the Greeks and a board as bare as a Roman altar
fw-iii1-408-01.text: bed／board 连食宿，board 又能看成饭桌。thinkamuddles 把思辨搅成结。译保留床硬、桌空及希腊与罗马的对称。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: rabbited kitchens and relief porridgers
fw-iii1-408-01.text: rabbited 见兔，porridgers 近 porridge 与 porringer。Gordon 连教区济贫供粥，译留厨房与救济粥碗，份量未定。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: a very few fortnichts since I was meeting on the Thinker's Dam
fw-iii1-408-01.text: fortnichts 近 fortnights，是以两周为单位。Thinker’s Dam 还可听 tinker’s dam 或 tinker’s damn。译用「双星期」「思想匠坝」。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: MacBlacks—I think their names is MacBlakes—from the Headfire Clump
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 保留一名错记再改。Gordon 将 MacBlakes 联想到 William Blake，又将 Headfire Clump 连到 Hellfire Club。都柏林山上确有该遗址，材料未证书中人物身分。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: no five hour factory life with insufficient emollient and industrial disabled for them that day o'gratises.
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 见证作 five hour，无 week。保留否定、五小时、润剂不足、工伤残废与白给一天。Gordon 听出 days of grace；各项辖属不稳，译用短节并列，未替原句补定工时制度。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Hagios Colleenkiller's prophecies
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Adomnán《圣科伦巴传》卷一记诸预言。Whetstone 在论文第153页将拟名与 Colmcille 相连；校样写 Columbkiller。正文留 colleen（姑娘）与 killer 的刺耳改形。未核定这句灾候见于哪条预言。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: After suns and moons, dews and wettings, thunders and fires, comes sabotag.
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 按两两列项可依次听一周的 Sun、Mon、Tues、Wed、Thurs、Fri；sabotag 同时近 sabotage 与 Samstag 的周六尾声。正文按天象列词，末尾译「破坏日」；星期读法仍属推测。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Tilvido! Adie!
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Gordon 将前声读作「直到再见你」，后声近告别的 adieu 并叠 die。译「待见！阿地哀！」保留回头与哀音。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: salve a tour, ambly andy, you possibly might be so by order?
fw-iii1-408-01.text: salve 可作祝安问候，tour 与 ambly 带巡视、行走；Andy 接上文 Handy。Gordon 听 by order 兼命令与邮政汇票。《尤利西斯·食人族》布卢姆想给玛莎寄 postal order，供对读。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: not what I wants to do a strike of work
fw-iii1-408-01.text: strike of work 听作 stroke of work（一番活计），也带停工罢工。上段刚提工场。两读拆入中文，保留肖恩推脱。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: condemned on me premitially by Hireark Books and Chiefoverseer Cooks
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 校样作 primatially，有首席教职一层；定稿 premitially 又可听预先。Hireark 贴近 hierarch 与 hire，Cooks 让上级名单换腔。正文留下先判与任官、厨房叠影。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Eusebian Concordant Homilies
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Eusebian 容 Eusebius 一读，Concordant Homilies 把讲道和协调／经文对读连缀。正文以拟书名译，具体对应哪套讲道未定。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: the book of breedings and so as it is becoming hairydittary I have of coerce
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 配种谱在此推出 hereditary（世袭），hairydittary 显 hair。of coerce 紧贴 of course，又露强迫。译作「带毛世袭，逼得我当然」。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Swann and beating the blindquarters out of my oldfellow's orologium oloss olorium
fw-iii1-408-01.text: orologium 近 horologium（计时器），拉丁 olor 是天鹅，照应 Swann。译留钟、天鹅名与三截拟音；盲暗与后座并在，所揍的具体物件未定。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: A bad attack of maggot it feels like. 'Tis trope, custodian said.
fw-iii1-408-01.text: maggot 令蛆与钻脑的怪念相碰。下一句看守插话，trope 叫作转义。正文保留两声部，蛆病的字面诊断撤掉。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: while keeping out of crime, I am now becoming about fed up
fw-iii1-408-01.text: fed up 同时承「受够了」与前段饱食。肖恩先说没犯事，再说兜圈厌倦。译「吃足受够」兼两层。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: new hikler's highways like them nameless souls, ercked and skorned and grizzild all over
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Gordon 先听 hiker。hik(l)er 字形又近 Hitler，荒林、兜路与无名魂容远足和政治层。译留希克勒与徒步，两读均不指定道路实址。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: the catchalot trouth subsidity as away out
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Gordon 从 catchalot trouth 听多捞鳟鱼，另记 McHugh 的 Catholic Truth Society。subsidity 像 subsidy 与 society，away out 兼出路、离得远。译用「鳟理补助」保留声义重叠。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: to isolate i from my multiple Mes on the spits of Lumbage Island
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 小写 i 对复数大写 Mes。Mink 将拟岛连到都柏林外的 Lambay，Fingal 郡资料可核岛名；拼形亦近 lumbago。译名留背字，保留尖滩和大小写之差。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: clogs, coolcellar and all, deep in my wineupon ponteen
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Gordon 连 coolcellar／coal cellar、wineupon／wide open、ponteen／poteen。译文不补酒泉，保留木屐、整座窖与私酿。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: unless Morrissey's colt could help me or the gander maybe at 49 as it is a tithe fish so it is
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 马驹、雄鹅、数字与什一税鱼逐项保留。Halper 从鱼及猪肚另联圣帕特里克肉变鱼故事，未据此落实动物、编号或地址。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: where on dearth or in the miraculous meddle of this expending umniverse
fw-iii1-408-01.text: dearth 使 earth 带匮乏；meddle 可听 middle 又带搅和；expending 将 expanding 换成耗费。译兼饥地、居中、搅局与开销。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: since it came into my hands I am hopeless off course to be doing anything concerning.
fw-iii1-408-01.text: off course 暂取迷路、偏航，也听成当然；it 在此悬着，Gordon 候下问才辨为信。译留「这事」并保留能力全失的口气。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: from franking machines, limricked
fw-iii1-408-01.text: franking machines 是邮资盖印机。limricked 既显 Limerick 地名，又听 limerick 打油诗。消息从器械传来，译保留拟诗调。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Speak to us of Emailia.
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 原文大写形似人名或地名，又夹 mail。译音保留疑形，未证具体指称。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: with tootlepick tact too and a down of his dampers
fw-iii1-408-01.text: tootlepick 同时露出轻吹和牙签，Gordon 听后半贴 tic-tac-toe。damper 可以压低琴弦响声，译留器件和声量。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: the gumpower and, by the benison of Barbe
fw-iii1-408-01.text: gumpower 容 gum（牙龈）、gunpowder 与力气。法国陆军炮兵资料称 Barbe 或 Barbara 为守护圣人，Gordon 也连此义。译并牙龈与火力。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: sixty odd eilish mires a week between three masses a morn and two chaplets at eve
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 保留六十余里、三台弥撒及两次串珠祈祷。eilish 近 Irish 或 Éilís，mires 兼里数与泥地，译用「爱尔兰泥里」。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: my answerers, Top, Sid and Hucky
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Twain《汤姆·索亚历险记》有汤姆、锡德与哈克。此处 Top、Sid、Hucky 可连读；只作互文，保留原有诨形。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: it is a veriest throth as the thieves' rescension
fw-iii1-408-01.text: throth 贴 truth／troth，rescension 可听 recension（修本）。以盗贼修本印证真话，令保证自带反讽。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: forstold for me by brevet for my vacation in life
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Gordon 从 forstold 听预告、先说、预先阻止。brevet 带任命，vacation 与 vocation 相撞。一处任职，另一处免差。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: disbarred after holy orders from unnecessary servile work
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 领圣职后可免杂役，也可读成禁止从事。正文以「禁我再服」同时留禁与免。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Weak stop work stop walk stop whoak.
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 三次 stop 可读动作，也像电报句号。前三项换元音，末尾 whoak 像喝令站住。正文复现三个停字。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: two housesleep there, then catch one nightmaze, then home to dearies
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 一宿、两宿各有屋子。nightmaze 叠夜路和梦魇；dearies 又可听 Derry。译文留夜班陷入迷路的声形。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: never get stuck to another man's pfife
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Gordon 从 pfife 听 fife（短笛）与 wife。该句和女人、朋友、敌手诸戒相连，译合「笛妻」。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Amen, ptah! His hungry will be done! On the continent as in Eironesia.
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 《马太福音》6.10 有奉行旨意、地如天。原句换成他的饥饿旨意、大陆如爱尔群岛，并在 Amen 后接 ptah 的啐声；译以呸塔兼拟音。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: with my fleshfettered palms on the epizzles of the apossels
fw-iii1-408-01.text: epizzles of the apossels 叠使徒书信与 pizzle 粗语。译「书鞭」，保留身体宣誓与写本同场。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: recite my grocery beans
fw-iii1-408-01.text: grocery beans 显杂货豆，又贴 rosary beads。后有 genuflections enclosed，把宗教屈膝礼写作随信附上。译用豆珠并留函件节拍。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Hek domov muy
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 捷克政府资料录国歌题 Kde domov můj，意为「我家何处」。Hek 与 muy 有改写，译以「嘿」保留起声，问家紧接下句土墩。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Greedo! Her's me hongue!
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Gordon 以 Greedo 连 Credo（信经），其中又有 greed；hongue 可听舌头与蜂蜜或亲称。译「信贪」并保留伸舌语。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: painted our town a wearing greenridinghued
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Gordon 对读 paint the town red。科克公共博物馆藏邮筒并记自由邦将旧红邮筒刷绿。小说字面仍刷全城，邮筒史放入注；骑行绿保留 riding。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: O murder mere, how did you hear?
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 惊呼带 murder，mere 可听法语 mère（母亲）。Gordon 也循听觉联想童话问耳朵。译以「妈呀，谋杀啦」保留惊呼与母称。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: smoiling the ily way up his lampsleeve
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 笑与油、灯连在一处。Gordon 将 ily 联系灯油；up his sleeve 又有藏在袖中之感。译保留笑、油与灯袖。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: The gloom hath rays, her lump is love.
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 幽暗句反而放光，lump 又近 lamp，顺接袖灯和提灯找人的狄奥根尼。译保留一团与灯。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Your diogneses is anonest man's.
fw-iii1-408-01.text: diogneses 叠 diagnosis 与 Diogenes，anonest 可听 an honest 又带 anonymous。Laertius 记狄奥根尼白昼点灯寻人；老实人的说法亦见 Baldwin 故事转述。译并无名及老实。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Thrubedore I did! Inditty I did. All lay I did.
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Gordon 从首两声听 troubadour 与 ditty，All lay 又可听 I’ll lay（我押注），lay 也有歌谣义。三次 I did 维持起伏，连后文《游吟诗人》。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Down with the Saozon ruze!
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Favereau 布列塔尼语词典可核 Saoz／Saozon，亦列 saoz ruz 例。Saozon 照英人，ruze 又近英语 ruse，红与诡计叠加。Mink 再联 Saxony。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: striding on the vampire and blazing on the focoal
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Gordon 对读威尔第《游吟诗人》内 Azucena 的 Stride la vampa。美国国会图书馆介绍 H. Millard 曲谱改编所用英文题 Forth stalks the vampire；可说明英词影子，乔伊斯所读谱本待核。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: See! blazing on the focoal. As see! blazing upon the foe.
fw-iii1-408-01.text: focoal 合火炉、煤与 foe 起声。两遍几乎相同，末处改成 foe。校样也留复唱。译以焦煤／仇敌保持同一动词及近声。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Like the regular redshank I am. Impregnable as the mule himself.
fw-iii1-408-01.text: redshank 字面红腿，也可作鸟名。下一句换骡子。保留红腿和骡子，不预定是鸟、赤足者或阵营绰号。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: an aughter impression of I was wrong. No such a thing! You never made a more freudful mistake
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 校样可见 after 改 aughter，留事后及女儿一类近声。freudful 贴 dreadful，又带 Freud；译留弗洛伊德名。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: What's pork to you means meat to me while you behold how I be eld.
fw-iii1-408-01.text: pork 到 meat，特指退回泛称。Gordon 兼读诺曼法语借词与古英语词的反差；eld 又近古老的 old。此句较第四套校样后来增入。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: ways of thinking from the prophecies. New worlds for all!
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Gordon 连《启示录》21.1–5 新天新地，也听 new words。正文只许人人有新世界，随后又说仅供绅士，保留张力。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: scotographically arranged for gentlemen only by a scripchewer in whofoundland who finds he is a relative
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Mink 从 scoto- 联苏格兰，Gordon 听近 scatography。scripchewer 合嚼稿与 scripture 读法，whofoundland 藏 Newfoundland，也让 who／find 复响。亲戚属发现者自认，未落实姓名。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: my extravert davy. Like glue. Be through.
fw-iii1-408-01.text: davy 容宣誓短语 affy davy（affidavit）、戴维灯与人名；Gordon 连煤火、灯光。科学博物馆有戴维矿灯实物。译用出面宣誓和外照灯，粘住及完全的短句各留。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Moyhard's daynoight, tomthumb. Phwum!
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Moyhard 可参 O’Hehir 检索摘文所联 Magh Ard，Logainm 地名表见 Maigh Ard／Moyard；地点仍存疑。Tom Thumb 见英格兰童话，译用拇指汤姆并留畸声收口。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: How mielodorous is thy bel chant
fw-iii1-408-01.text: miel 是蜜，bel chant 是美歌，又可回听 belch；Gordon 并听 malodorous，故前一声赞美还带饭后气味。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: exqueezit thine after draught
fw-iii1-408-01.text: exqueezit 近 exquisite 又露 squeeze；draught 容饮、气流与船迹。译取余饮与挤，接下文酸汁；余气及船迹留注。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: O phausdheen phewn, from Pontoffbellek till the Kisslemerched our ledan triz will be?
fw-iii1-408-01.text: O’Hehir 第229页将 phausdheen phewn 释作金发孩子，并把 Pontoffbellek 连到弗马纳 Belleek。Kisslemerched 所指未定；ledan triz 暂取宽树，主句保持问而未完。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: whether furniture would or verdure varnish?
fw-iii1-408-01.text: would／wood、varnish／vanish 交错，furniture／verdure 将家具与青草木并置。Gordon 联砍树取木，正文保留问句，青绿上漆及消退并列。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: naturally incensed, as he shook the red pepper out of his auricles
fw-iii1-408-01.text: incensed 带发怒，也容焚香；耳中红胡椒落进火与食物一串意象。原动作从耳朵甩出，译按原次序。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: the physiog of this furnaced planet would I be doing besides your verjuice?
fw-iii1-408-01.text: physiog 近 physiognomy。furnaced 接上一问 furniture，verjuice 接 verdure，并保留酸葡萄汁。译留脸、炉和汁，句尾仍突兀。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: for the teom bihan
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 像 for the time being；O’Hehir 分别列 teom 和 bihan 一读，后者可连 Behan。译仅取时间短，姓名与词源未定。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: under the past purcell's office
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 听作 past 与 parcel，另露 Purcell 姓。此处接邮局分拣员；上文号角可与 Purcell 曲目对读，尤需区分不同经文。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Miss Enders, poachmistress and gay receiver
fw-iii1-408-01.text: poachmistress 近 postmistress，又留偷取。receiver 可指收件人，也属职务用语；Gordon 另听 gay deceiver。伊名保留，不坐实生平。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: the Scotic Poor Men's Thousand Gallon Cow Society
fw-iii1-408-01.text: Gordon 对读《尤利西斯·伊萨卡》苏格兰寡妇保险社，后者确见保单清单。拟会名另换穷汉、千加仑奶牛；取消将公司名当实在单位的读法。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: twentytwo thousand sorters out of a biggest poss of twentytwo thousand, mine's won
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 同数两次，mine’s won 兼 one／won。后接 too much，又能连成一、二。译保留上限、人数及说话人一号。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: privet stationery and safty quipu was ate up larchly
fw-iii1-408-01.text: privet 兼女贞和 private；quipu 字面结绳，safty 近 safety。larchly 则将 largely 染成落叶松，延续木材、信纸与啃食。正文保留女贞、结绳，落叶松入注。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: Colpa di Becco, buon apartita!
fw-iii1-408-01.text: colpa 明说过错，becco 容公山羊义，又近喙；apartita 有离去声，也像拟名。译留归咎与告别，未认定专名。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: a verdigrease savingsbook in the form of a pair of capri sheep boxing gloves
fw-iii1-408-01.text: verdigrease 合 verdigris（铜绿）和 grease（油）。capri 可作地名，又跟山羊词形相关。以簿和拳套连写，保留油、兽皮、账簿与外形。

fw-iii1-408-01.lemma: their sindybuck that saved a city
fw-iii1-408-01.text: 可听德语 Sündenbock（替罪羊）；Duden 连《利未记》16.21–22。救城是原句另加，正文同时译明。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: cadenus and goat
fw-iii1-413-01.text: Swift 原诗题为 Cadenus and Vanessa。此处 Vanessa 位置换成 goat，并紧邻 kidding（逗弄、小羊声）及 totether（拴在一起）。Gordon 将此问接上段啃信纸的羊。中文保留卡德努斯、玩笑、拴绳及山羊。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Gracehoper
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 近 grasshopper（蚱蜢），又可听见 grace 与 hoper。国会图书馆所载伊索寓言英译里，蚱蜢挟琴求食，蚂蚁让他跳舞。此处借核琴舞母题，乔伊斯所用版本及角色与谢姆关系仍待核。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Ondt
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 与 Gracehoper 对举，后文有 ant、and、andt 等变形。《丹麦语词典》将 ondt 收在 ond 下，兼及恶与痛楚。正文沿用「翁特」，留住善恶悬念。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Book of Breathings
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 都灵埃及博物馆藏 Petamenophis《呼吸之书》，列明此类文本丧葬用途。书名接虫棺与醒来；具体见证仍待核。bed him 近 bade him，又藏卧床。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Tingsomingenting
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 小屋名，416.27 再现。Knuth 读出丹麦语 en ting som ingenting，意近「形同无物的一件东西」。正文留拟音。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: hegelstomes
fw-iii1-413-01.text: Bonheim 对照德语 Hegel 与 Hagel（冰雹）；Gordon 另听 tomes（大部头），厚、密接风雪。译文留黑格尔、雹和著作声。墓碑仅属可能联想。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: my selary as a paykelt is propaired, and there is a peg under me and there is a tum till me.
fw-iii1-413-01.text: paykelt 近 packet、pay、Celt，selary 近 salary，propaired 有预备与先付。peg 与 tum 保留栓位和肚腹。跨段接上 so long as，保留只要句式。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: To the Very Honourable The Memory of Disgrace, the Most Noble
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 献辞堆尊称，Disgrace 却将 His Grace 的尊称扭成耻辱。用「辱下遗念」，保留尊号与辱字同列。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Sometime Sweepyard at the Service of the Writer. Salutem dicint.
fw-iii1-413-01.text: Sometime 可指昔日任职，Sweepyard 把身份压作扫院差。Gordon 另听 sweetheart。Salutem 带拉丁书信致安，dicint 保留变形，中文用短促问安接悼辞。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: the Loyd insure her!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: insure 留保险动作。Lloyd’s 自述沿革，说明这家的保险语境；句法又像替亡者祈求。译用保险祝愿，保留戏拟悼词。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: both mudical dauctors from highschoolhorse and aslyke as Easther's leggs.
fw-iii1-413-01.text: mudical、dauctors 可听 medical doctors 与 daughters，并露 mud；highschoolhorse 将学校和高马挤在一起。Easther’s leggs 近 Easter eggs，亦唤 Esther。译用蛋腿留拼词，身份仍悬。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: a wellteached nonparty woman that I ever acquired her letters
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 相对从她收信，Gordon 另读识字学文字。nonparty 与教养并列，译文保留识字及来函，两读不限定同一动作。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: she shuk the bottle and tuk the medascene all times a day.
fw-iii1-413-01.text: shuk／tuk 押短声，摇药瓶和喝药也可听成给婴儿摇奶瓶。medascene 搭戏景声，译并药和场面。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: had tastes of the poetics, me having stood the pilgarlick a fresh at sea
fw-iii1-413-01.text: Gordon 对照 a touch of the rheumatics，诗趣添病痛。pilgarlick 带秃头、受窘之人，亦写得近 garlic，译用秃蒜倒霉汉。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: P.L.M. Mevrouw von Andersen was her whogave me a muttonbrooch, stakkers for her begfirst party.
fw-iii1-413-01.text: P.L.M. 原样保留，未证是祷词缩写。姓氏从 Sanders、Shunders 再变 Andersen，muttonbrooch 并羊肉和胸针。stakkers、begfirst 的报酬或宴名细节未定。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Honour thy farmer and my litters.
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 《出埃及记》20.12 命敬父母。这里改成你的 farmer 与我的 litters；litters 又近 letters，折回儿崽、信件。译作「信崽」。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: my last will intesticle wrote off in the strutforit
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 遗嘱套语 last will and testament 向 intestate（无遗嘱）和 testicle（睾丸）折转。strutforit 容径直写下及昂首走。译「睾证遗嘱」保留法律与身体笑话。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: what squaton a toffette
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 动作是蹲坐，toffette 近 tuffet（矮座），也有童谣语感。译「蹲坐在小脚凳」，未给童谣人物另添出场。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: her skin was exposed to the air
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 字面露在空气中。Gordon 又听 air／heir，和遗嘱见证一带相照。正文保留露肤，继承一层入注。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: two little ptpt coolies worth twenty thousand quad
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 校样留 ptpt；《致斯黛拉书简》有 Ppt、MD 等昵称。两个小苦力及两万均照录，quad 暂音译，未坐实币种或性别。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: herewitdnessed with both's maddlemass wishes to Pepette for next match
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 见证词与佩佩特、下场配对相连。Gordon 听出 Christmas、Michaelmas；maddle 又显疯乱，译「疯弥撒」。具体节令未定。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: May doubling drop of drooght!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: Gordon 从 doubling 听出 Dublin，并听 my darling 和 drought 的饥渴。译以都柏林、双倍和渴倒并响。缩写保留，不释签署人身份。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Two venusstas! Biggerstiff! Qweer but gaon!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: Gordon 把这句连回两位 Esther 与 Swift。Swift 的1708年拟预言署 Isaac Bickerstaff，Biggerstiff 容笔名及更大更硬的叠读；拟呼暂随音。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Be trouz and wholetrouz!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 扭动真话、全句真话的作证套语，重复 trouz 接先前遗嘱见证。译保留两次真。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Hooraymost! None whomsoever, Shaun replied, Heavenly blank!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 答自传一问，开头可听欢呼，又把人物说成无名、空白。Gordon 听 blank 避咒字；正文留老天与空白，不把欢呼坐实为归家。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: he had intentended and was peering now rather close to the paste of his rubiny winklering
fw-iii1-413-01.text: intentended 重叠意向与持续，winklering 有 wink 与 ring；paste 又可指仿宝石料或膏糊。译取重说、眨戒和膏糊。实物与用途待考。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: rawcawcaw romantical
fw-iii1-413-01.text: raw 紧挨两声 caw。中文用「生嘎嘎」保留粗生、乌鸦叫和浪漫气并在。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: in ex-voto, pay and perks and wooden halfpence
fw-iii1-413-01.text: ex-voto 指还愿物，紧接工钱和外快。Swift《布商书简》第一封明说 William Wood 铸造半便士；小说同时把 Wood 变成木料，译作「伍德木半便士」。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: some rhino, rhine, O joyoust rhine
fw-iii1-413-01.text: rhino 在钱款清单里可作钱，rhine 再转莱茵。三个短重拍照列，不限定是具体币制。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: was handled over spondaneously by me
fw-iii1-413-01.text: spondaneously 近 spontaneously 又露 spondee（双重音步）。Gordon 读 by me 也敲两拍；译用「我自己」及双重音。后句 spont 又将同音嵌入「花费」。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: my illwishers' Miss Anders; she woor her wraith of ruins the night she lost I left!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 人名是 Anders，与上页 Enders 音近。wraith 带幽影，又近 wreath（花冠）；she lost I left 两事并列。译保留她失、我走及残垣幽影。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: in the ligname of Mr van Howten of Tredcastles, Clowntalkin, timbreman
fw-iii1-413-01.text: Gordon 连 in the name、拉丁 lignum（木）及 lingam。Mink 联 Howth Castle 与 Clondalkin；Logainm 核后者，Tredcastles 尚有三堡称及都柏林盾徽线索。拟名暂留木材和说话声。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: the Bois in the Boscoor, our evicted tenemants
fw-iii1-413-01.text: Bois 兼 boys 与法语木林；Mink 又联法语 bassecour（禽院）及比斯开湾。校样可分成 Bosco or。译保留林中孩子及遭逐房客，Boscoor 的确定地点待考。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: I never spont it. Nor have I the ghuest of innation on me the way to.
fw-iii1-413-01.text: spont 近 spent/spontaneous，回照 spondaneously；校样写 of a nation，定稿 innation 可听 notion，ghuest 又近 ghost 与 guest。译保留花钱否认和半点念头。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: It went anyway like hot pottagebake.
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 像热饼一样卖得快或散得快，pottage 又是浓粥。译「热粥饼」，未补谁买与银钱去处。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: I am as plain as portable enveloped, inhowmuch, you will now parably receive
fw-iii1-413-01.text: plain 既正直、清楚，也可指黑啤；portable 近 porter 及可携寄递物。Gordon 将 enveloped、receive 连信封与酒，parably 预告寓言。译用波特酒封套保留牵引。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Mooseyeare Goonness's registered andouterthus barrels
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 校样作 Guinness’s，本稿再拟作 Goonness’s。Mink 连健力士酒厂；厂方藏品说明其用木桶运酒。Gordon 又听 Monsieur 与 Mother Goose。现实桶运不能证小说挂号手续。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Quick take um whiffat andrainit. Now!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 压扁语音中仍有 whiff 与 drain。动作先闻再喝尽；急呼留在句末。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: So vi et! we responded. Song! Shaun, song! Have mood! Hold forth!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: So vi et 可听 so be it 和 Soviet；Gordon 又听 mood／moed（胆气）。译用苏维也并将壮胆接酒桶与催唱。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: I apologuise
fw-iii1-413-01.text: apologise 中突起 guise 的近形。「告罪告嘴」留结巴般的起拍。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: spinooze you one
fw-iii1-413-01.text: spin a yarn 是编故事；词尾近 snooze（打盹）。译文同留纺线与催眠。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: grimm gests of Jacko and Esaup
fw-iii1-413-01.text: gests 可读行状，近 jests；grimm 兼响阴沉与格林。两名接近雅各与以扫，Esaup 又近 Aesop。《创世记》叙以扫为食物让出长子名分。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: fable one, feeble too
fw-iii1-413-01.text: fable 与 feeble 相撞，one 与 too 又可听成 one、two。以「寓言一则，弱言也一则」留自嘲与数拍。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: the casus, my dear little cousis
fw-iii1-413-01.text: casus 为个案，cousis 近 cousin。「小表亲，来瞧瞧这桩表案」留亲缘与拟判例口吻。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: husstenhasstencaffincoffintussemtossemdamandamnacosaghcusaghhobixhatouxpeswchbechoscashlcarcarcaract
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 长声插在案名之前。开头近咳声；后段音节及语种组合待核。正文留整串。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: a partner pair of findlestilts to supplant him
fw-iii1-413-01.text: findlestilts 可听见 fiddle 与 stilts；supplant 令替换动作带出脚底联想。伊索寓言英译可对照琴舞母题。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Floh and Luse and Bienie and Vespatilla
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 四个拟名接续虫语，可分别联想跳蚤、虱、蜜蜂和胡蜂。正文留人名口吻及先后次序。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: pupa-pupa and pulicy-pulicy and langtennas and pushpygyddyum
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 蛹与蚤叠唱；langtennas 可并听 lawn tennis 和 long antennae。末项暂以推扭蹭动作保留游戏口令，词源待核。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: to commence insects with him
fw-iii1-413-01.text: insects 与 incest 近声，接求偶和口器动作，也可听见 sex。「交虫」留交媾与虫身。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: there mouthparts to his orefice and his gambills to there airy processes
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 女方口器向他孔窍，他双腿向女方突肢。there 近 their；gambills 近 gambol，腿还在跳。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: even if only in chaste, ameng the everlistings, behold a waspering pot
fw-iii1-413-01.text: chaste 近 chase 或 jest；everlistings 可听常青与常听；waspering 可听 wasp 与 whisper。草稿同位作 wateringpot，译文保留壶形。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: of curse melissciously
fw-iii1-413-01.text: of course 转作咒语，melissciously 近 maliciously。虫群语境又引出蜜蜂联想，译作「咒然蜜恶」。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: fore feelhers, flexors, contractors, depressors and extensors
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 草稿作 fore antennas。刊文 feelhers 带出 feel her，随后列屈、缩、降、伸动作。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: lamely, harry me, marry me, bury me, bind me
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 四个动作各带第一人称宾语，harry、marry、bury 连押，bind 收紧。译文四拍同以「我」收尾。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: fourmish her in Spinner's housery
fw-iii1-413-01.text: fourmish 近 furnish，也可听见蚁声。Spinner 与 housery 可读纺丝、屋舍，并牵出 hosiery 的袜业近声。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: so summery as his cottage, which was cald fourmillierly Tingsomingenting, groped up
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 草稿写 growed up；刊文换作 groped up，小屋生长带着盲摸之态。fourmillierly 近 familiarly，兼带蚁声。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: funny funereels with Besterfarther Zeuts, the Aged One
fw-iii1-413-01.text: funeral 和 reel 叠在滑稽曲舞里。「殡轮曲」留丧仪和回转。Zeuts 贴近 Zeus。早稿 Besterfather 少一个 r，通行文还能听到 farther。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: wigeared corollas, albedinous and oldbuoyant
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 花冠也近衣领，wigeared 可听假发和翼耳。Gordon 将 albedinous 连天体反照率，oldbuoyant 连旧人和浮力。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: inscythe his elytrical wormcasket
fw-iii1-413-01.text: inscythe 近 inside，又露镰刀。elytrical 叠鞘翅与电气。Gordon 提出蝉壳及电棺联想，译文留虫棺泛称。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Dehlia and Peonia, his druping nymphs, bewheedling him
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 两名近大丽花和芍药。nymph 兼仙女、若虫；druping 近低垂，bewheedling 近哄诱。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: compound eyes on hornitosehead
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 复眼位于角质头壳，hornitose 又近 horny。旁置语关系松动，译文仅留形貌。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Auld Letty Plussiboots to scratch his cacumen and cackle his tramsitus
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 搔头尖与咯咯送行并行。tramsitus 近 transitus（过渡、离世），又可听到电车。老莱蒂后半拟名待核。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: seven bolls of sapo, a lick of lime, two spurts of fussfor, threefurts of sulph, a shake o'shouker, doze grains of migniss and a mesfull of midcap pitchies
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 草稿写 soap 与 madcap pitchies，译文据此读皂、疯帽，壶近 pitcher。保留拟计量与舐、喷、摇。配方用途存疑。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: The whool of the whaal in the wheel of the whorl of the Boubou from Bourneum
fw-iii1-413-01.text: whole、whale／wall、wheel、whorl 连转。布布与布尔尼厄姆留拟名。Gordon 联想到 Barnum 展演，所指存疑。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: tambarins and cantoridettes soturning
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 鼓铃旁有 cantor 歌声和 cantharides 斑蝥近响；soturning 叠旋转与 Saturn。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: eggshill rockcoach their dance McCaper in retrophoebia
fw-iii1-413-01.text: rockcoach 拆换 cockroach 声序，又是一辆车。Gordon 读出蹦跳虫舞及菲比；NASA 证实菲比逆行公转，本文用字仍属释读。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: beck from bulk, like fantastic disossed and jenny aprils
fw-iii1-413-01.text: beck from bulk 近 back from bulk，所指未定。disossed 可读去骨；Gordon 听出舞者 Jane Avril，正文留拟名。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: a mutter and doffer duffmatt baxingmotch
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 母女、喃语和聋哑拳赛声影相叠。早稿已有 mutter & deffer baxing motch，后增 duffmatt。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: myrmidins of pszozlers pszinging
fw-iii1-413-01.text: myrmidins 可听蚁群或密尔弥冬人，pszozlers 似醉鬼，pszinging 带嗡音。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Satyr's Caudledayed Nice
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 拟曲名近 Saturday night，又把萨堤尔与热奶酒搅入。草稿已有此名，保留夜晚、睡前饮。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Hombly, Dombly Sod We Awhile
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 开头近 Humpty Dumpty，整句近童谣坐墙句；sod 又引向土中睡伏。与上文蛋丘并读。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Ho, Time Timeagen, Wake!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: Time 重叠同时引出 Tim Finnegan 和醒转、守灵。三支拟曲从周六夜、暂歇唱到再醒。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: sciencium (what's what) can mute uns nought, 'a thought
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 叠否定，uns 近 us，mute 可听静默或低语。吐不出一念，与下句艺术唱声呼应。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: the Great Sommboddy within the Omniboss
fw-iii1-413-01.text: Sommboddy 近 somebody（有号人物），Omniboss 同听 omnibus 与 boss。译文留车和大人物。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: the Little Newbuddies that ring his panch
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 新伙伴、新芽与小人物近声。ring 既围绕又报声，panch 近 paunch 肚腩。Gordon 提出土星环读法。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: A high old tide for the barheated publics and the whole day as gratiis
fw-iii1-413-01.text: high tide 与尽欢时节叠合，publics 可连 public houses，gratiis 留免费口吻。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: O'Cronione lags acrumbling in his sands but his sunsunsuns still tumble on
fw-iii1-413-01.text: Gordon 将拟姓联系克罗诺斯及土星。sunsunsuns 同闻太阳与儿孙，译文叠写两声；沙与踢拍承时间。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: so as everwhy, sham or shunner, zeemliangly to kick time
fw-iii1-413-01.text: kick time 将时间踢回脚跟脚趾拍。sham／shunner 可听作佯装／规避，具体声源与评价对象待核。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Grouscious me and scarab my sahul!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 感叹语里插入甲虫，sahul 近 soul，又使整句带丧葬语色。「甲护我魂」保动作与虫，不指定古埃及词源。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: What a bagateller it is! Libelulous! Inzanzarity!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: bagateller 近小事，也像称呼。Libelulous 可听诽谤声和蜻蜓拟形，Inzanzarity 像发疯与闹剧叠音。暂依三个短促怒拍。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Pou! Pschla! Ptuh! What a zeit for the goths!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 三声短喷后接 zeit（时世）；goths 也让耳朵听成 gods。译文让哥特、诸神同现。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: not being a sommerfool, was thothfolly
fw-iii1-413-01.text: summer 混 fool，thoughtfully 里混 Thoth 和 folly。先讥夏傻子，再摆智慧架势。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: making chilly spaces at hisphex affront of the icinglass of his windhame
fw-iii1-413-01.text: spaces 可带 faces 的做脸声，hisphex 亦可读 his face 和 Sphex（细腰蜂属名）。icinglass 混冰与 isinglass，windhame 处夹窗和家，不把冰写成材质判定。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: cold antitopically Nixnixundnix
fw-iii1-413-01.text: cold 又近 called。德语口语 nix 即 nichts，三次否定经 und 相连。antitopically 夹蚁、反向及地处字样；中文旧屋名保留。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: We shall not come to party at that lopp's, he decided possibly, for he is not on our social list.
fw-iii1-413-01.text: lopp 擦过丹麦语 loppe，又近 that lot。社交名册语气侵入虫宴，possibly 给断然拒绝打个折。第12层草稿的 that lopp’s party 较顺，通行文本特意挪动语序。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Nor to Ba's berial nether, thon sloghard
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 叠 burial、neither 及下界声。Navarrete Franco 据 Budge 将 Ba 连丧葬灵魂观；另有其他拟名解释。正文保留巴与葬仪。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: this oldeborre's yaar ablong as there's a khul on a khat
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 丹麦语 oldenborre 指金龟子一类，yaar 近年。Gordon 读猫胎帽，Navarrete Franco 联系 khat 尸身。正文先留猫，另一路入注。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Nefersenless, when he had safely looked up his ovipository
fw-iii1-413-01.text: Nefersenless 近 nevertheless，又带古埃及名声。looked up 擦过 locked up；ovipository 兼及产卵与存放。译作「锁好卵库」，不固定为翁特自身器官。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: he loftet hails and prayed
fw-iii1-413-01.text: loftet 使致礼带上抬举动作。Gordon 还听到近代政治礼声，所指尚属释读。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: May he me no voida water! Seekit Hatup!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: void water 保排水的身体口吻。Navarrete Franco 读作 Sekhet-hetepet，又听见 seek it 与昂首动作；正文两声取拟音。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: May no he me tile pig shed on! Suckit Hotup!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: tile 旁叠猪与排泄。Budge 述丧葬仪式用未遭猪等踩踏的泥瓦作画；原文把图像近声扭成脏话。Suckit Hotup 又可听 suck it hot up，与上一声并押。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: As broad as Beppy's realm shall flourish my reign shall flourish!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: reign 可转听 rain。Navarrete Franco 将贝皮祷句联系佩皮王名、名号兴盛及丧葬祈愿。并列两次 flourish。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: As high as Heppy's hevn shall flurrish my haine shall hurrish!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: haine 法语为恨；与 heaven、happy 近声所带喜乐相对。hurrish 叠 hurry 与 flourish，保恨意疯长。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Shall grow, shall flourish! Shall hurrish! Hummum.
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 三拍祷词从长、盛到急盛，结尾押回含混鼻音。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: a weltall fellow, raumybult and abelboobied
fw-iii1-413-01.text: Weltall 是寰宇，weltall 又近 well tall。raumybult 接德语空间声和 roomy built；胸部拟词存疑。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: bynear saw altitudinous wee a schelling in kopfers
fw-iii1-413-01.text: Gordon 以铜板叠成一先令释身量微小。altitudinous 撑高，wee 再缩，译文用「矮高」保冲突；旧译另加挣钱说，此处无相应动词。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: sair sair sullemn and chairmanlooking when he was not making spaces in his psyche
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 庄肃声重复，spaces 近做脸；psyche 先有心灵义，Gordon 另连蝶翼普绪刻。保留心／眼和主席／副主席两组对举。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: but, laus! when he wore making spaces on his ikey, he ware mouche mothst secred and muravyingly wisechairmanlooking.
fw-iii1-413-01.text: laus 可听拉丁赞声及德语虱；mouche、mothst 带苍蝇和蛾音。muravyingly 让人联想蚁，也近 marvelously；wisechairmanlooking 可并听英明与 vice-chairman。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Now whim the sillybilly of a Gracehoper
fw-iii1-413-01.text: whim 兼任性与 when 的关节声，sillybilly 用叠音先定滑稽口吻。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: jingled through a jungle of love and debts and jangled through a jumble of life in doubts afterworse
fw-iii1-413-01.text: jingled／jungle 和 jangled／jumble 两组响声相推；love／life 与 debts／doubts 互换。afterworse 将 afterwards 拐向越混越糟。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: wetting with the bimblebeaks, drikking with nautonects, bilking with durrydunglecks
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 湿、喝、赖账串成三拍。nautonects 近仰泳蝽属 Notonecta，durrydunglecks 可听见污泥和粪甲。馆藏仰泳蝽只核属名，正文无须定种。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: horing after ladybirdies (ichnehmon diagelegenaitoikon)
fw-iii1-413-01.text: ladybird 同时落在虫名与女伴，horing 添寻欢口吻。Gordon 据 McHugh 将 ichnehmon 连姬蜂类，并回指 418.15 寄生描写；括注余字形待核，正文照录。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: he fell joust as sieck as a sexton and tantoo pooveroo quant a churchprince
fw-iii1-413-01.text: sexton 是教堂司事，可管墓地；病与穷各拉一重教会角色。churchprince 又擦过穷如教堂鼠的谚意。拟意大利语叠入比较，中文用「简直」留反讽。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: wheer the midges to wend hemsylph or vosch to sirch for grub
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 去路和觅食同时发问。midges 带蠓虫，grub 是口粮又近幼虫，hemsylph 擦过 himself。译文保留虫语，vosch 的具体源头待核。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: for his corapusse or to find a hospes, alick, he wist gnit!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: corapusse 让 corpse 与 carapace 相擦；hospes 兼主人、客人，并可引出临终收容。gnit 在否定上再添虱卵／小飞虫声。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Bruko dry! fuko spint!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 可听 broke、dry、spent 与粗口，破产、干涸、花尽轮番挤出。第12层草稿的 Fuko 大写，稿段所录通行文用小写。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Sultamont osa bare! And volomundo osi videvide!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: bare、videvide 共推空无，又可听 mondo 的世界义。Gordon 提到空柜读法，首个拟词所指未定，正文暂留音。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Nichtsnichtsundnichts!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 德语 nichts 叠三次，用 und 接末项，回响 415.29 翁特宅名 Nixnixundnix。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Not one pickopeck of muscowmoney to bag a tittlebits of beebread!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: pickopeck 近微量与戈比，muscowmoney 合莫斯科与钱，bag 擦过买和装袋。beebread 是蜂群保存的花粉粮，中文留「蜂粮」。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Iomio! Iomio! Crick's corbicule, which a plight!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 两声叹词后仿举基督身体起誓；Crick 同听鸣蟋。corbicule 连蜂后足花粉篮，译句保篮及惊呼。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: O moy Bog, he contrited with melanctholy.
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 神名句兼英语祷声和斯拉夫语 Bog。contrited 作动词，melanctholy 把忧郁折向圣洁口吻。与下一声悔罪辞变拍同读。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Meblizzered, him sluggered!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 第12层草稿分写 Me blizzered，通行见证黏合。blizzard、bless，slugger、sluggard 等声相冲；Gordon 据 McHugh 连《箴言》6.6 懒汉观蚁。译文留我／他和风雪、懒汉。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: I am heartily hungry!
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 悔罪辞以 O my God 呼告，随后说 I am heartily sorry。Joyce 让饥饿闯入忏悔句型，译为「我打心眼里饿啊」。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: eaten all the whilepaper, swallowed the lustres
fw-iii1-413-01.text: whilepaper 摇摆在墙纸与吃掉光阴之间，lustres 可见吊灯与光泽。译文保留室内实物及耗时联想。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: forty flights of styearcases, chewed up all the mensas and seccles
fw-iii1-413-01.text: styearcases 叠岁月、阶梯，四十保留。mensas、seccles 可按桌椅读，也带时序串项的近声，暂不把每件配定单位。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: ronged the records, made mundballs of the ephemerids
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 啃档卷，把蜉蝣及短时日纪搓成丸。Gordon 引 McHugh 释蜉蝣短命，又读出泥粪球，与前文粪甲相应。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: vorasioused most glutinously with the very timeplace in the ternitary
fw-iii1-413-01.text: voracious、gluttonous、glutinous 一口相咬；timeplace 同吞时间地点。ternitary 兼有 termite、eternity 的影子，「白蚁永穴」搭留两声。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: not too dusty a cicada of neutriment for a chittinous chip so mitey
fw-iii1-413-01.text: cicada 置于食量衡量处，neutriment 近 nutriment，chittinous 近几丁质，mitey 又小螨又强大。译文以「一蝉」拟量，几丁与小屑并留。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: when Chrysalmas was on the bare branches, off he went from Tingsomingenting.
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 圣诞混蛹及晶霜，落光枝。中文用「蛹诞节」保节名与虫蜕，屋名照应 414.34。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: He took a round stroll and he took a stroll round and he took a round strollagain
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 三回拖同一脚步，round 和 stroll 互换，末回黏住 again。译文三个分句轮换「绕」「溜达」。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: the grillies in his head and the leivnits in his hair
fw-iii1-413-01.text: grillies 听似蟋蟀，leivnits 叠虱卵和 Leibniz。莱布尼茨《新论》前言用小浪累成海涛声说明微知觉，可邻读下句海声；此处直接引述关系待证。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: made him thought he had the Tossmania
fw-iii1-413-01.text: Tossmania 近 Tasmania，又使 toss 与 mania 呼应转圈、头晕。译成「塔斯颠狂」，地名补注。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Had he twicycled the sees of the deed and trestraversed their revermer?
fw-iii1-413-01.text: twicycled 同听二次和双轮，trestraversed 带三次；sees of the deed 近 Dead Sea，revermer 可听 river、mer 及倒转感。Gordon 另提罗马 Trastevere，正文未定精确行程。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: Was he come to hevre with his engiles or gone to hull with the poop?
fw-iii1-413-01.text: hevre 兼勒阿弗与 heaven，hull 兼船壳与 hell，engiles 擦过 angels 与 engines，poop 兼艉楼和 pope。两问留航境与审判之声。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: The June snows was flocking in thuckflues
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 六月雪接塔斯拟名，当地六月入冬。flocking 可写雪结团，也牵出絮屑；flues 可指烟道。译文保雪团、烟道。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: millipeeds of it and myriopoods
fw-iii1-413-01.text: millipede、myriapod 作雪的计量，像把千足、万足直接搓作数量。译文以雪为主，留虫足。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: a lugly whizzling tournedos, the Boraborayellers
fw-iii1-413-01.text: whizzling 添风啸，tournedos 可听 tornado 及法语菜名；Boraborayellers 把波拉波拉与嚷声绞在一起。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: blohablasting tegolhuts up to tetties and ruching sleets off the coppeehouses
fw-iii1-413-01.text: 爆吹瓦屋，扯下冰霰／屋板。Gordon 听 sleets 兼 slates，coppee 兼铜；咖啡屋声与铜屋料同在。tetties 词源存疑，正文先取顶尖。

fw-iii1-413-01.lemma: ragnowrock rignewreck
fw-iii1-413-01.text: Ragnarök 连诸神覆亡，第二拍又带 rig 与 wreck，遂从宇宙末日回到翻船。校读剧情参考《女先知的预言》目录说明。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Baile-Atha-Cliath
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Baile Átha Cliath 是 Dublin 的爱尔兰语地名，汉译保留音写与通用地名。稿段连字符和 1132 日期照录。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Culex
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Culex 是库蚊属名，又是《维吉尔附录》传世小诗题。诗题可作对照，乔伊斯是否直接用此诗仍待核。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Pulex
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Pulex 是蚤属名，与 Culex 同拍；本句由蚤唤醒蚊。此处借分类核词形，正文沿用虫名和拟音。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Homo Vulgaris
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 拟物种名指常人。前置双生两项和 tick 的钟声、叮咬同落凡人身上，中文保「滴答叮」。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Ad majorem l.s.d.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 耶稣会格言 Ad majorem Dei gloriam 指上主更大荣耀。Joyce 把旧币镑、先令、便士缩记插入赞辞，再落 Divi gloriam；译文同留币名与颂声。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Miss Take
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Opened by 后像小姐署名，连读又是 mistake。译作「误拆小姐」，保误拆批语和人名。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: penetrant, siphonopterous spuk.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 跨页 irritant／penetrant 同押，随后把虹吸声与蚤目混成鬼响。Bonheim 释 Spuk 为闹鬼、喧嚣，Gordon 另听喷气的虹吸管。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Grausssssss! Opr! Grausssssss! Opr!
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Bonheim 读 Graus（惊骇）、Oper（歌剧），Gordon 还听出大歌剧。重叠两拍，延长嘶尾。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: blind as batflea
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 瞎蝙蝠俗喻揉进跳蚤。紧随 not a leetle beetle 的甲虫声，省略量级反衬识虫本领。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: his good smetterling of entymology
fw-iii1-417-01.text: smetterling 近 smattering（粗通）及 Schmetterling（蝶），entymology 把昆虫学与词源学绞合。正文「虫词学」留学问双向，蝶音留注。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: asped nissunitimost lous nor liceens
fw-iii1-417-01.text: asped、lous、liceens 可擦过 asked、虱、license；否定又带连番塞音。具体拆词待核，中文暂作不问虱、不讨虱照。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: in the vico, phthin and phthir, on top of his buzzer
fw-iii1-417-01.text: vico 留小巷和人物名声。phthin／phthir 贴薄、虱的拟音。Gordon 读 buzzer 为嗡响的头，并联倒栽。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: wheer would his aluck alight or boss of both appease
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 三重近音问幸运落在何处，怎样讨好那位管两边的。Gordon 也对照 I.1 捣蛋女的门前提问。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: makes the aquinatance of the Ondt
fw-iii1-417-01.text: aquinatance 将 acquaintance 和 Aquinas 靠在一起。Gordon 联翁特主教相；正文用「阿奎那识」接再会。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: these mouschical umsummables
fw-iii1-417-01.text: mouschical 近 musical，umsummables 又可听嗡鸣、合奏与不可相加。第12层写 theirselves，稿段所录版本写 themselves。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: motylucky if he will beheld not a world of differents.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: motylucky 牵蛾、蝶与幸运；differents 并听差别、微分，摇摆在两个虫声世界之间。保留否定，以「要是见不出」落句。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Behailed His Gross the Ondt, prostrandvorous upon his dhrone
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Gordon 听出 His Grace 的敬称及 postprandial 的饭后义。gross、vorous 添肥大、饕食，dhrone 仍近 throne。译作「肥下」，让称颂带挖苦。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: his Papylonian babooshkees
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Papylonian 叠 Babylon、papa，可联教皇装束；后词近 babouches 便鞋、babushka。正文留鞋，服饰其余联想入注。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: smolking a spatial brunt of Hosana cigals
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Gordon 拟 brunt 为钝头雪茄，Hosana 近欢呼祝辞；cigals 同听 cigar、cigale 蝉。第12层在 spatial 与 brunt 间另有 beetler，通行文已删。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: unshrinkables farfalling from his unthinkables
fw-iii1-417-01.text: unthinkables 近代称底衣的 unmentionables。farfalling 近 falling、farfalla（蝶），德语 verfallen 也是 Bonheim 的读法。何物掉落仍存疑。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: swarming of himself in his sunnyroom
fw-iii1-417-01.text: swarming 和 warming 相擦，一人取暖却闹如虫群，并牵出 sunnyroom 的温暖。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: his comfortumble phullupsuppy of a plate o'monkynous and a confucion of minthe
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 晚餐塞满肚，monkey nuts 指花生，monkynous 又带苦修者 monk。confucion 近 infusion，字形又牵孔夫，minthe 保薄荷。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: a conformed aceticist and aristotaller
fw-iii1-417-01.text: aceticist 近醋酸和 ascetic，aristotaller 听见 Aristotle 和 teetotaller。两称号与眼前饱餐反衬。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: as appi as a oneysucker or a baskerboy on the Libido
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 吸蜜与晒日头并列，Libido 可听欲力也近 Lido 水滨浴场。译文保场景和拟名，未定物种。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Floh biting his leg thigh and Luse lugging his luff leg and Bieni bussing him under his bonnet
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 咬腿股、拖腿、帽下亲吻三拍依次落实。luff 带航海声；此处 Bieni 省尾 e，后文 Bienie 又补回，中文同作比妮。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Vespatilla blowing cosy fond tutties up the allabroad length of the large of his smalls
fw-iii1-417-01.text: blowing 带吹与暖声，the large of his smalls 把小衣裤夸成大号。tutties 仍留拟声，动作方向沿裤长往上。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: As entomate as intimate could pinchably be.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: entomate 将 entomo- 虫与 intimate 亲密叠合；pinchably 增添夹、掐触感。译文留「虫亲」「肉亲」。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Emmet and demmet and be jiltses crazed and be jadeses whipt!
fw-iii1-417-01.text: emmet 是蚁，与骂声 demmet 连押。jilt、jade 带薄情和贬称，Gordon 还听见 Judas／Jesus 近响。正文保咒骂，近声留注。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: schneezed the Gracehoper, aguepe with ptchjelasys and at his wittol's indts, what have eyeforsight!
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 喷嚏夹雪声，aguepe 可擦过法语 guêpe（黄蜂）和 agape；wittol 又是容忍伴侣不忠者，indts 近 ends。eyeforsight 在 Bonheim 处连德语嫉妒声。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: that true and perfect host, a spiter aspinne
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 东道主又可听圣餐饼与寄生宿主；spiter／aspinne 叠恶意与织蛛。Gordon 以捕食连前后虫身，正文留席间欢迎与恶蛛同场。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: the greatest spass a body could with his queens laceswinging
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 德语 Spaß 指戏乐，queens 在虫场含虫后，laceswinging 又擦过 lacewing 草蛉。译文保虫后、甩带与摆翼。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: spizzing all over him like thingsumanything in formicolation
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 嘶喷与蚁走般刺痒相混。thingsumanything 倒应格雷斯霍珀小屋 Tingsomingenting，保「样样有」对早先无物。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: an allallahbath of houris
fw-iii1-417-01.text: all、Allah、bath 连音，houris 与浴场画面挤在同场。Gordon 对照 597.14 反复神名，正文用「安拉啦」保叠响。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: ameising himself hugely at crabround and marypose
fw-iii1-417-01.text: ameising 带 Ameisen 蚁声及逗乐、积聚，crabround 近蟹绕圈，marypose 可听西语 mariposa（蝶）、Mary 和 pose。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: chasing Floh out of charity and tickling Luse, I hope too, and tackling Bienie, faith, as well, and jucking Vespatilla jukely by the chimiche
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 仁爱、希望、信德插在四项动作中，顺序照录。末句 jucking／jukely 叠音，chimiche 的烟囱读法暂留。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Never did Dorsan from Dunshanagan dance it with more devilry!
fw-iii1-417-01.text: O Hehir 将两名分读为 Dorsán（蚱蜢）及 Dún Seangáin（蚁堡）。保多尔桑拟名，也译出「蚁堡」，接蚁蝗舞步。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: The veripatetic imago of the impossible Gracehoper on his odderkop in the myre
fw-iii1-417-01.text: veripatetic 擦过 peripatetic，imago 兼形象与虫的成形阶段。odderkop 可听怪脑壳及丹麦语蜘蛛 edderkop；正文留头栽泥里的动作。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: after his thrice ephemeral journeeys, sans mantis ne shooshooe, featherweighed animule
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 三回短旅接蜉蝣，又可听 journée。featherweighed 是以羽比重的称量；大英博物馆图版可核阿尼纸草秤心图。螳螂／鞋声暂照拟声。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: sinctifying chronic's despair, was sufficiently and probably coocoo much for his chorous of gravitates.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: sinctifying 合罪、圣化与指意，chronic 拉回时光；coocoo 同响布谷与疯闹。末语合沉重、庄严与合唱，Gordon 与上句秤羽连读。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Let him be Artalone the Weeps with his parisites peeling off him
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Artalone 夹 art alone，parisites 夹 Paris 与寄生者。Gordon 并听 Parthalon 与 Arthur Guinness，后一路和下一称号对照。正文留人名、独艺及巴黎。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: I'll be Highfee the Crackasider.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Highfee 可听高酬，Gordon 听出 Iveagh；Crackasider 近 crusader，亦可带裂嘴笑声，接下文翁特大笑。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Flunkey Footle furloughed foul, writing off his phoney
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 四次 f 头韵将跑腿、遣休和勾销挤作一串。phoney 近伪造又近声学；假票只是与勾销相配的读法。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Conte Carme makes the melody that mints the money
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 伯爵称呼和歌声邻靠，melody、mints、money 三拍由旋律挤出钱。下句旧币缩记乘势插入赞辞。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: A darkener of the threshold. Haru?
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 门槛暗影与呼召句。第12层草稿是在 threshold 后问号、Haru 后叹号，稿段所用见证调转。Gordon 将门槛联系《亡灵书》卷章，Haru 的神名联系仍存疑。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Orimis, capsizer of his antboat, sekketh rede from Evil-it-is, lord of loaves in Amongded.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Orimis 近祈祷语 oremus 和 Osiris。Navarrete Franco 核渡向亡界的蚁舟；rede 是劝告，又可听 reed 芦苇。保拟地「亡中地」、掌饼者和问策关系。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Be it! So be it! Thou-who-thou-art, the fleet-as-spindhrift, impfang thee of mine wideheight. Haru!
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Gordon 将 Thou-who-thou-art 连《出埃及记》神名自称。飞沫保疾行，impfang 近德语收纳词，wideheight 把宽与高合为领受之物。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: The thing pleased him andt, and andt,
fw-iii1-417-01.text: andt 轮替 ant、and、Ondt，末逗把话送进歌行。译文保持两次蚁声。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: He larved ond he larved on he merd such a nauses
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 笑声混幼虫 larva，merd、nauses 把粪与鼻响、恶心声带入。Gordon 据此读翌句嗓门与排泄错置。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: The Gracehoper feared he would mixplace his fauces.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: fauces 为咽口，亦向 feces 擦音。mixplace 不只是笑破喉，而是混错部位；译成「错换了地方」。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: I forgive you, grondt Ondt, said the Gracehoper, weeping, For their sukes of the sakes you are safe in whose keeping.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: grondt 与 Ondt 同押，sukes／sakes／safe 连换喉声。译文保哭着原谅、受照应诸位，以及前后两行唱拍。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Teach Floh and Luse polkas, show Bienie where's sweet And be sure Vespatilla fines fat ones to heat.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 三项吩咐接原四个拟虫名。heat 同听 eat，肥虫与热食都保留；唱词未指明猎物虫种。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: As I once played the piper I must now pay the count
fw-iii1-417-01.text: pay the piper 的习语拆成当初吹笛、今日付账。count 既能计账，又回声前文伯爵 Conte。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: So saida to Moyhammlet and marhaba to your Mount!
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Moyhammlet 可连 my hamlet；Gordon 并录爱尔兰语读法。marhaba 在句中像问候，又与 Abraham 字母相换；正文拟名，其他宗教联想存疑。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Let who likes lump above so what flies be a full 'un; I could not feel moregruggy if this was prompollen.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: lump、flies、full 让团块、虫飞和饱腹同拍。moregruggy 叠不满与昏倦，prompollen 听花粉；上行句法仍有歧义。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: I pick up your reproof, the horsegift of a friend, For the prize of your save is the price of my spend.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 赠马俗谚遇上德语 Gift（毒物），又可联木马礼。prize／price 与 save／spend 成对，挖苦褒奖和代价是一笔账。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Can castwhores pulladeftkiss if oldpollocks forsake 'em Or Culex feel etchy if Pulex don't wake him?
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 两行用性词、虫名挪写 Castor、Pollux。《奥德赛》同叙这对兄弟交替死生，照应 wake 的唤醒及守灵。正文留拟称，与库蚊、蚤并列。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: A locus to loue, a term it t'embarass, These twain are the twins that tick Homo Vulgaris.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: locus 接 to 可拼听 locust，term it 可拼听 termite。loue 或作 love；中文用「一处可恋」「白蚁期」留空间与时间，蝗虫音借上下文补。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Has Aquileone nort winged to go syf
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 意语 aquilone 兼北风与风筝；Gordon 从 Aquileone 听出鹰与狮，nort 朝北，go syf 可能拐向南去。译名留狮翼和南北反向。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Since the Gwyfyn we were in his farrest drewbryf
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Gordon 将 Gwyfyn 连 gryphon，又把末语听成 first drew breath。译文留格威芬拟音和同处一息的句态，拟名语源未定。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: And that Accident Man not beseeked where his story ends
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Accident 可连偶事，也贴 Occident，与后文东方相对。疑问保留故事尽头，暂不指定哪一人。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Since longsephyring sighs sought heartseast for their orience?
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 西风 zephyr 与长忍叹气兼在；heartseast 近 heart’s-ease，又带心与东。orience 将东方、方向摆在句末。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: We are Wastenot with Want, precondamned, two and true,
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 不浪费便不缺用的谚语拆成两名，节俭与贫缺并肩；precondamned 添预先定罪，two and true 仍留双数。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Till Nolans go volants and Bruneyes come blue.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Nolans／Bruneyes 可并听诺拉、棕眼和诺拉城人布鲁诺；Stanford 词条仅核布鲁诺籍贯。译文留诺兰、翱翔及棕眼转蓝。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Ere those gidflirts now gadding you quit your mocks for my gropes
fw-iii1-417-01.text: mocks 和 gropes 既分讥嘲、摸索，也回响 I.6 始于 152 页的 Mookse 与 Gripes。gidflirts、gadding 保轻佻走动。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: An extense must impull, an elapse must elopes,
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 广延向内收，流逝又成私奔。第12层草稿句尾为句点，稿段沿通行文逗点，接下句清点与报时。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Of my tectucs takestock, tinktact, and ail's weal;
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 查存货的 takestock 和几声滴答同排，尾语叠 ail、weal 与 all’s well。Gordon 听作报时人的口令。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: As I view by your farlook hale yourself to my heal.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: farlook 可听远视，hale 兼健壮与牵拽，heal 兼治与脚跟 heel。Gordon 联雅各抓脚跟，正文先保远望、拖、治的动作。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Partiprise my thinwhins whiles my blink points unbroken on
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Partiprise 可读分担、偏向，thinwhins 兼消瘦与低哀声。blink 一闪又要 unbroken，保凝视之矛盾。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Your whole's whercabroads with Tout's trightyright token on.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: whole、where、abroad 铺开全身与广处，Tout 亦近托特名。第12层写 whereabroads、tightyright，稿段沿 whercabroads、trightyright。信物具体所指存疑。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: My in risible universe youdly haud find
fw-iii1-417-01.text: in risible 可听可笑、不可见，以及 in my universe 的倒置。译文将两层视听同留。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Sulch oxtrabeeforeness meat soveal behind.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: beef、veal 夹进 before、behind。前后既是肉身空间，也可牵时间；meat 又贴德语 mit。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Your feats end enormous, your volumes immense,
fw-iii1-417-01.text: feats／feet 与 volumes 的成就、脚步、卷帙、体积、音量互照；「脚也大」「嗓门更大」补足歌者口吻。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: May the Graces I hoped for sing your Ondtship song sense!
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Graces 加 hoped for 回写 Gracehoper，兼有恩惠与女神群像；颂他唱出道理，紧挨节拍反问。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Your genus its worldwide, your spacest sublime! But, Holy Saltmartin, why can't you beat time?
fw-iii1-417-01.text: genus、spacest 夹属种名与空间；意语 saltamartino 是跳虫方言名，也拼入 Martino。末问既问打拍子，也问能否赢过时间，译文合为一声。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: In the name of the former and of the latter and of their holocaust. Allmen.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 三项奉名呼应《马太福音》28.19 的礼式，第三项转向全燔祭。Allmen 合众人与 Amen，译「众门」。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: How good you are in explosition!
fw-iii1-417-01.text: exposition 和 explosion 同起，评歌一开口即爆。正文「爆讲」留讲述和炸声。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: How farflung is your fokloire and how velktingeling your volupkabulary!
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 民俗、词汇、叮铃与欲感并连。Gordon 听 volupkabulary 夹 Volapük，国家图书馆另核语种背景。中文保沃拉普克近声。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Qui vive sparanto qua muore contanto.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 意大利谚语有「怀希望而活，唱着歌而死」的采录变体。Joyce 拧写 vive、sparanto、contanto；sparanto 近 Esperanto，亦可听射击。译文留断裂口令和拟音。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: O foibler, O flip, you've that wandervogl wail withyin!
fw-iii1-417-01.text: foibler 听得寓言讲者与小毛病；flip 可取轻嘴。wandervogl 叠游鸟名声，withyin 保哭声在内。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: It falls easily upon the earopen and goes down the friskly shortiest like treacling tumtim with its tingtingtaggle.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 耳开便进，向下滑成喝糖浆和肚内节拍。Gordon 另联 036 页的 Frisky Shorty 与 Treacle Tom，后者留「糖浆汤姆」一声。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: The blarneyest blather in all Corneywall!
fw-iii1-417-01.text: blarney 连花言、blather 连胡扯，Corneywall 将 Cornwall 谐成俚声。「康尼沃尔」留地名偏音。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: decent Lettrechaun, we knew (to change your name of not your nation) while still in the barrel
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Lettrechaun 合信字与小妖，话还扣着桶中人。第11层写 if not，稿段见证用 of not。括语仍保姓名与国族对照。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: read the strangewrote anaglyptics of those shemletters patent for His Christian's Em?
fw-iii1-417-01.text: anaglyptics 指凸纹，Shem 与 letters 同在；letters patent 可借听专利诰书，Em 的全称未定。正文留作拟称。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: —Greek! Hand it to me!
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Greek 后紧接索信，中间无叙述插话；希腊语也可作难懂话。Gordon 另接 glyph 的希腊词根。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: plosively pointing to the cinnamon quistoquill behind his acoustrolobe
fw-iii1-417-01.text: plosively 兼爆破音，cinnamon 是桂皮色，quistoquill 留鹅笔和拟问音，acoustrolobe 贴听觉与耳垂。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: as afterdusk nobly Roman as pope and water could christen me
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 入暮罗马身分借教皇和水洗来，pope 也擦声 soap，把洗礼拉到洗澡。中文留教皇加水。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Look at that for a ridingpin! I am, thing Sing Larynx, letter potent
fw-iii1-417-01.text: ridingpin 可听 writing pen，唱嗓接写笔。第11层合写 letterpotent，稿段分写；Sing Larynx 留叫名和歌喉。
