fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: play the sem backwards like Oscan wild
fw-iii1-417-01.text: sem 近 Shem、same，又可与右向左书写并读。Oscan wild 兼王尔德拟名与 Oscan 语言声。Helen Sword 将邻近讥语联系通灵出版物；此处直接引用关系未定。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: in shunt Persse transluding from the Otherman or off the Toptic
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Persse、Otherman、Toptic 擦过波斯、奥斯曼和科普特。第11层明写 Ottoman，可核演变；transluding 将翻译混游戏，暂译「译戏」。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: off the types of my finklers in the draught or with buttles, with my oyes thickshut and all.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: types 连字模、finklers 近 fingers，draught 可听草稿又可同瓶装对读。闭紧双眼仍能弄字，照录那股自夸。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: But, hellas, it is harrobrew bad on the corns and callouses.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: hellas 兼叹声 alas 与希腊；harrobrew 近 Hebrew、harrow 和 brew。难懂语言落到脚上鸡眼硬茧，中文留咯痛。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: from theodicy re'furloined notepaper
fw-iii1-417-01.text: theodicy 是神义论，又贴 The Odyssey；Gordon 以失窃信笺联 Poe 题名。furloined 另带卷束，保「卷走」和「失窃」。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: for indeed I am, pay Gay, in juxtaposition
fw-iii1-417-01.text: pay Gay 可听字母 P.G.。Gordon 引 McHugh 作邮务总长联想，并读出地位声。正文拟人名，兼留所在位子。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: It is a pinch of scribble, not wortha bottle of cabbis.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: pinch 使潦草字成一撮，cabbis 近卷心菜。Gordon 读 bottle 可指扎起的一束，旧译残汁欠据。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Overdrawn! Puffedly offal tosh!
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 透支也像过度描摹。puffedly、offal、tosh 等声逐拍喷出；末标点稿段依 Faded Page 的叹号，JJDA 1939 转录为点号。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Besides its auctionable, all about crime and libel!
fw-iii1-417-01.text: auctionable 近拍卖，亦擦过 actionable（可起诉）；两路接估价及诽谤。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Nothing beyond clerical horrors et omnibus to be entered for the foreign as secondclass matter.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: clerical 可指教士或文书，拉丁状补语添分类语气；secondclass 同落邮类与品级。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: The fuellest filth ever fired since Charley Lucan's.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 多枚 f 起声，fuellest 使污物宜燃。Charley Lucan 近 Charles Lucas；《爱尔兰传记辞典》记其文字曾公开焚烧。正文留拟名与焚文，具体指涉仍属读法。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Flummery is what I would call it if you were to ask me to put it on a single dimension
fw-iii1-417-01.text: flummery 兼糊状食物、空话。single dimension 把评语压成一线；后连 pronounced、orally，维持肖恩口述姿态。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: the mother and Mr Unmentionable (O breed not his same!) has reduced to writing without making news out of my sootynemm.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 两位写下废料，括语咒再生同种。sootynemm 带煤灰、名字，亦可听城市名。早稿见 sootyname，后层改 sootynemm。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: When she slipped under her couchman.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: couchman 让 couch 和 coachman 重叠。保她滑到身底，译文以「卧榻车夫」留两具场景。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: And where he made a cat with a peep.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 片语压短，以猫与窥眼拼动作。具体牵出何种人物或俗语仍存疑。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: How they wore two madges on the makewater. And why there were treefellers in the shrubrubs.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: madges 擦过 badges 和女名，makewater 可读放水，treefellers 带砍树者、三汉及三叶草。保二三相继及灌丛，删旧译自行增写的溺水。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Then he hawks his handmud figgers from Francie to Fritzie down in the kookin.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: hawks 是兜售，handmud figgers 可作手泥人、图画或手势。保从弗朗西到弗里茨及灶下方位。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Phiz is me mother and Hair's me father. Bauv Betty Famm and Pig Pig Pike.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: phiz 指脸相，Hair 可听毛发与 Herr。Gordon 另提画师 Phiz 与《画像》开头毛脸父亲。后两名保拟音及 Pig 的重唱，不坐实身分。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Their livetree (may it flourish!) by their ecotaph (let it stayne!).
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 活树与拟碑邻立，ecotaph 擦过 cenotaph、epitaph 和回声。Knuth 释 stayne 作留立，与活树祝愿对排。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: With balsinbal bimbies swarming tiltop. Comme bien, Comme bien! Feefeel! Feefeel!
fw-iii1-417-01.text: balsinbal／bimbies 连唇声，先写成群上梢。Comme bien 近问价，Feefeel 可听费用或嫌恶。译文保叠唱，各字根仍待核。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: And the Dutches dyin loffin at his pon peck de Barec.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Dutches 近 duchess，又有 Dutch 声；dyin loffin 可听笑死。第9层稿见 Baree，刊文 Barec，先依音留称呼。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: And all the mound reared. Till he wot not wot to begin he should.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 先拱起土丘，再两挫 wot。他不知从何说起，译文复写两遍「不晓得」。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: An infant sailing eggshells on the floor of a wet day would have more sabby.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Gordon 举 Carleton 叙儿童在潮湿地板放蛋壳船为对照，已核扫描所载动作。sabby 近 savvy，保小孩胜一筹的讥评。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Letter, carried of Shaun, son of Hek, written of Shem, brother of Shaun, uttered for Alp, mother of Shem, for Hek, father of Shaun.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 先携，次写，再替／给发话、收信。of 与 for 的归属均有游移；译文保各人亲属身份。第11层尚无 uttered。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Initialled. Gee. Gone. 29 Hardware Saint.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Gee 既像惊声又读 G，接 Gone。Hardware Saint 借 St. 混街与圣，短戳分开。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: 31 Jan. 1132 a.d. Here Commerces Enville.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 保完整日期。Commerces 混 commerce 与 commences，Enville 近法语城内。第11层日期为 31 Jun, 11.32，通行形改月及数字。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Tried Apposite House. 13 Fitzgibbets.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Tried 兼试投、审判；Apposite 近 opposite。Fitzgibbets 擦过 Fitzgibbon 姓及 gibbet 绞架，保门牌和刑具声。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Tax 9d. B.L. Guineys, esqueer. L.B.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 9d. 依旧币为九便士，B.L. 与 L.B. 保倒置。Guineys 同听几尼、人名，esqueer 叠绅士称谓与奇怪。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: 12 Norse Richmound. Nave unlodgeable.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Norse 夹 North，Richmound 听 Richmond。Nave 兼教堂中殿与 knave，故将无处借宿两路并列。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Finn's Hot. Exbelled from 1014 d. Pulldown.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Exbelled 混驱逐与钟声。1014 可照克朗塔夫战年；正文保数字和拟地，具体被驱者存疑。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Fearview. Opened by Miss Take. 965 nighumpledan sextiffits.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Fearview 近地名 Fairview；误拆之后接九百六十五和夜间拟证书。数字照录，sextiffits 形源待核。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Shout at Site. Roofloss. Fit Dunlop and Be Satisfied.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 场址、失顶与广告口号相接。Dunlop 牌名保留，博物馆藏充气轮胎可证品牌业务，句内商品仍容别解。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: At sea. D.E.D. Place scent on. Clontalk.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: D.E.D. 可听 dead，scent 近 cent 且为气味。Clontalk 以 talk 扭写附近 Clontarf，地名释读置于注。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: P.V. Arrusted. J.P. Converted to Hospitalism. Ere the March past of Civilisation.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: 缩记留原样，Arrusted 混逮捕与生锈。march past 可指列队经过，又带文明进程及三月声。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: 2 Milchbroke. Wrongly spilled. Traumcondraws. Now Bunk of England's.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Milch 带奶，spilled 兼洒与 spelled。Traum 带梦，Bunk 近 Bank，译文保提款、银行与空铺。街址所指存疑。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Drowned in the Laffey. Here. The Reverest Adam Foundlitter.
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Laffey 兼笑与利菲，Foundlitter 兼拾信、拾弃，并可连 Findlater，保两个拟语。

fw-iii1-417-01.lemma: Since Cabranke. Seized of the Crownd. Well, Sir Arthur. Buy
fw-iii1-417-01.text: Cabranke 听见候车处；Crownd 同听王冠及人群。Buy 是跨页广告的首字，需与下一稿段 Patersen’s Matches 连读。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Boston (Mass)
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 地址连写中的地点，紧接不可能的日期 31 Jun. 13, 12。保留原文数字，不把它归并成1912年；离散族群通信终点的解释未证。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Ullhodturdenweirmudgaardgringnirurdrmolnirfenrirlukkilokkibaugimandodrrerinsurtkrinmgernrackinarockar
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 本底本去两处行末断字后实数101字母，仍照排印连缀。第15层 mandodrerin 与刊文／底本 mandodrrerin 相差一个 r。《欺骗古鲁菲》可核 Mjöllnir、芬里尔、洛基和苏尔特等近形；对应只到若干词片，其余不逐片定源。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: TCD
fw-iii1-421-01.text: Gordon 解作都柏林三一学院，医学院沿革可查。缩写夹在肝脏和上菜之间，学医、解剖与吃食的联想并存。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Cecilia's treat
fw-iii1-421-01.text: Cecilia’s treat 听如 Cecilia Street，街上曾设天主教大学医学院，有校史可查。treat 另作款待，solo 接圣塞西莉娅与音乐联想。两所医校的名称见各自资料，不由此断言谢姆就读经过。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Jon Jacobsen
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 人名安在一口猛饮里。Gordon 引 Glasheen 联系 John Jameson，品牌资料可核这姓名。正文仍译变音后的约恩·雅各布森；丹麦作家读法有待补证。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Flannelfeet
fw-iii1-421-01.text: flannel、feet 字面作法兰绒脚。Gordon 提出病人袜套的读法，可接前句肺痨；正文保留骂语和衣物。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Patersen's Matches. Unto his promisk hands.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 上一稿段 Buy 与此处牌名合成广告。promisk 近 promise 和 promiscuous，下一批语保两层。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Search Unclaimed Male. House Condamned by Ediles.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 邮务未领邮件与无人认领男子叠合。危房公告紧接，保市政官口吻。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Closet for Repeers. 60 Shellburn. Key at Kate's. Kiss.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: Repeers 同听 repairs 和 re-pee。门牌、钥匙、亲吻连写，后两项还回响凯特保钥。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Isaac's Butt, Poor Man. Dalicious arson.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 巴特人名、利菲河巴特桥和屁股成串，arson 又近 arse。桥档案仅核地点；此处仍留纵火与拟称。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Justiciated. Kainly forewarred.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 拟法办批记之后，kindly／Cain、forewarned／war 抢声，回到该隐兄弟冲突。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: All reddy berried. Hollow and eavy.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: already buried 同红莓错响；后组既是中空、沉重，又似圣诞冬青与常春藤。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Overwayed. Understrumped. Back to the P.O. Kaer of.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 超重、欠票、退邮局依序排。Kaer of 近 care of，并照开篇凯特转钥声。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Too Let. To Be Soiled. Cohabited by Unfortunates.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 招租、出售广告变成厕所和污物，住户语含困厄与同居两层。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: His Bouf Toe is Frozen Over.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 肥胀脚趾旁听 beef tea。保冻住的脚趾及牛汤近声。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: 31 Jun. 13, 12. P.D. Razed. Lawyered. Vacant. Mined.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 六月三十一日不可能，数字故依见证分写。Razed／Lawyered 可听 raised／lowered，又转拆楼与司法。P.D. 留缩记。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Here's the Bayleaffs. Step out to Hall out of that, Ereweaker, with your Bloody Big Bristol.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: Bayleaffs 同月桂叶和执行法警，Ereweaker 近 Earwicker 又耳弱。Bristol 可接酒桶等读法，正文顺下文桶塞声。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Bung. Stop. Bung. Stop. Cumm Bumm. Stop. Came Baked to Auld Aireen. Stop.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 同有桶塞、叩门和电报 STOP，末组兼 back、baked、醉返。五组拟节奏贴四次「止」。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: —Kind Shaun, we all requested, much as we hate to say it,
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 先礼称，再说难以开口。requested 兼请问与请求，保问话的客气外壳。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: since you rose to the use of money
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 套用懂得用理性的说法，改成懂得用钱。与前文问及金币、邮务生计照应。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: without suggesting for an instant, millions of moods used up slanguage tun times as words
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 遮掩话、「百千万回」、俚语与酒桶挤在同一句。moods 兼语气，tun 近 ten，又是大桶，补「成桶十倍」。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: as the penmarks used out in sinscript with such hesitancy by your cerebrated brother—excuse me not mentioningahem?
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 笔迹跟口语计量，sinscript 夹罪与文体，cerebrated 兼动脑和被称颂。mentioningahem 以清喉替不提的人，保咳声。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: —CelebrAted! Shaun replied under the sheltar of his broguish
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 肖恩复述时把 cerebrated 扳成 CelebrAted，中字母突显纠声。sheltar／broguish 可听乡音与遮蔽；音形也可带粗鞋联想。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: vigorously rubbing his magic lantern to a glow of fullconsciousness.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 用力擦亮魔灯，灯光和神志同时转亮。后文拟人名又引提灯者，不把两灯认作同物。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: HeCitEncy! Your words grates on my ares.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 上句 hesitancy 变声，内嵌 H、C、E。ares 擦过 ears 与 arse，把刺耳牵向粗口。译文补耳和屁股。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Notorious I rather would feel inclined to myself in the first place to describe Mr O'Shem the Draper with before letter
fw-iii1-421-01.text: Notorious 置首，顶替先前 CelebrAted。布商名唤起 Swift 署名 Drapier；before letter 可读前述信及前缀 O。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: as should I be accentually called upon for a dieoguinnsis to pass my opinions, properly spewing, into impulsory irelitz.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 语音与诊断俱在；dieoguinnsis 近 diagnosis、Diogenes 与 Guinness。拉尔修载提灯、住瓮，供与魔灯、酒桶邻读。irelitz 可听 Irish 和语言班；impulsory 兼冲动与强制。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: as to the views of Denmark. No, sah!
fw-iii1-421-01.text: Denmark 也像把 penmarks 听岔，Gordon 又对照 293.12 地名。保丹麦和口头拒答，未定所指见解。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: before my high Gee is that I much doubt of it.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: high Gee 可听音高 G 与对上主起誓，回声邮签 Gee／Gone。自称全信，尾句却深疑。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: I've no room for that fellow on my fagroaster, I just can't.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: Gordon 读寄宿学校跑腿名册，roaster 添烤灼声。第15层分句，通行稿逗号叠喘，译文短句留重复。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: learn from Rooters and Havers through Gilligan's maypoles
fw-iii1-421-01.text: Gordon 读收听新闻；Rooters／Havers 擦过 Reuters／Havas，机构资料只核名称史。报杆转出天线声，Gilligan 所指未定。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: a nice pathetic notice he, the pixillated doodler, is on his last with illegible clergimanths boasting always of his ruddy complexious!
fw-iii1-421-01.text: pixillated 可取昏醉、疯癫。第15层用 clergimanitis，通行改 clergimanths，疾病、教士与读不清混入脸红自夸。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: She, the mammy far, was put up to it by him, the iniquity that ought to be depraved of his libertins
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 被撺掇者是母亲，撺掇者接祸根；depraved 近 deprived，libertins 混自由与放荡。跨页处分延续同一人。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: to be silenced, sackclothed and suspended, and placed in irons
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 堵嘴、麻衣、悬停与上镣依次接。suspended 可听停职和吊挂，正文并留。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: into some drapyery institution off the antipopees for wordsharping only if he was klanver enough to pass the panel fleischcurers and the fieldpost censor. Gach!
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 布商继续出现在拟机构里，antipopees 合对跖与反教皇。wordsharping 贴削笔与磨词，panel 近 penal，fleischcurers 夹肉与腌治。末句为勉强闯关条件，Gach 单作厌声。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: fullblown fact and well celibated
fw-iii1-421-01.text: fullblown 写事实吹胀，也可说病势发展完全。celibated 近 celebrated，却把 celibate 塞进庆典，正撞上下文离婚法庭。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: the four divorce courts and all the King's paunches
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 四庭可能借都柏林 Four Courts 改名添入离婚；paunches 实写鼓肚。Gordon 另听见御邮封袋，与本章邮差相接。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: the solitary from seeing Scotch snakes
fw-iii1-421-01.text: solitary 可略去 confinement 作独囚读。Scotch 可指苏格兰，也可指威士忌；酒后见蛇，仍保留蛇形。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: a lowsense for the production of consumption
fw-iii1-421-01.text: lowsense 取 licence 音影，也留 low sense。consumption 可指肺痨，又是耗费；把消耗当作工场产品，正成反语。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: dalickey cyphalos on his brach premises
fw-iii1-421-01.text: Gordon 并读 dolichocephalic、brachycephalic 两套头形术语。译文留长短相衬；达利为拟音，具体人名与场所待核。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: purge his contempt and dejeunerate into a skillyton be thinking himself to death
fw-iii1-421-01.text: purge contempt 接藐视法庭的解除用语，又作排泄读；déjeuner 与 degenerate 在进餐声里碰撞。skillyton 保 skeleton 骨架及 skill 声影。第15稿层有插入标点，正文照底本连读。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Flattyro!
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 可拆 flat、tyro，承前一声脚骂；flat 亦可指平庸。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Thou. (I beg your pardon.) Homo!
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 先喊汝，插一句致歉，又喊人。Homo 可唤起拉丁「人」及 Ecce homo，也可能带当时的贬称声影；译文保留突兀换称。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: putting his bedfellow on me! (like into mike and nick onto post)
fw-iii1-421-01.text: on me 与两组介词、动作相扣。mike 似话筒，nick 可近人名或刻痕。关系留在硬把同床人往身上搁的怪句里。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: The criniman: I'll give it to him for that!
fw-iii1-421-01.text: criniman 可听 criminal，也可循 Gordon 取毛发。以扫自带毛人声影，见《创世记》27.11；此处借影，身份仍未定。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: the lobbard change hisstops
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 《耶利米书》13.23 问豹能否换斑点。lobbard 叠懒汉或笨汉声，hisstops 把 spots 换成 stops，音栓与行文停顿皆可听见。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Is he on whosekeeping or are my!
fw-iii1-421-01.text: whosekeeping 拉扯由谁照管与谁供养。are my 有 am I 声影，原句错拧人称，译文稍留颠倒。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Obnoximost posthumust!
fw-iii1-421-01.text: obnoxious 吞入 most，posthumous 又挨近本章 postal 词群；这里是骂语，具体生父与出生时序未定。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: his unique hornbook and his prince of the apauper's pride
fw-iii1-421-01.text: hornbook 指旧式识字板，可与 unique 合听独角。prince 和 pauper 疑戏拟马克·吐温书名；pride 接下一句学徒傲气。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: a mosselman's present! Ho's nos halfcousin of mine, pigdish!
fw-iii1-421-01.text: mosselman 可听旧称 Mussulman，旋接猪菜盘，结尾还露 ham 声影。第15层作 He’s nos，1939 刊文与本项目底本留 Ho’s nos；不据草稿修正。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: famish with the cuistha first. Aham!
fw-iii1-421-01.text: famish 与末尾 ham 声影相牵；Aham 亦像清嗓。cuistha 暂按拟音落笔，词根和所指待核。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: his prentis' pride in your aproper's purse
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 学徒傲气进钱袋，反扣上文穷王子傲气；原句连用 p 音，中文以反复的傲气和钱袋衔接。aproper 是否另带专名，仍待核。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: with yet an esiop's foible, as to how?
fw-iii1-421-01.text: esiop、foible 可听 Aesop、fable，又牵以扫及小癖。末问从肖恩骂语转作听众谦辞，接前面的蚁蝗寓言。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: it is partly my own, isn't it? and you may, ought and welcome
fw-iii1-421-01.text: partly 只认一份，回应前文追问。may、ought、welcome 连排，省去同一个动作，许可里又添催促。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: as his hunger got the bitter of him, a hearty bite out of the honeycomb of his Braham and Melosedible hat
fw-iii1-421-01.text: got the bitter 扭转 got the better，与蜂巢甜味相冲。Gordon 另提「吃帽子」誓语。第15层把姓称与可吃分开写，刊文合成 Melosedible，译文把梅洛、蜜味和可食放在一顶帽上。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: tryone, tryon and triune
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 从试一个、试戴拐进三位一体，同一串 tr 音兼作叫卖与神学术语。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Ann wunkum. Sure, I thunkum
fw-iii1-421-01.text: Gordon 将 Ann wunkum 听作含满嘴再说 and welcome。中文把「欢迎」塞进一声「唔」，后接同样含混的「琢摸」。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: honorey causes, through thelemontary channels long agum
fw-iii1-421-01.text: honorey 撮合 honour 和 honey，可听荣誉头衔惯用语 honoris causa。thelemontary 同时挨近 elementary 与 alimentary，渠道又成消化道。agum 含 ago、gum，译文留在含混口吻。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: the Baden bees of Saint Dominoc's
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 蜂承蜂巢与蜜誉。Gordon 把 Baden 联系古蜂化石，又提圣者引蜂传说。正文保留地名、圣名和夸古声，具体地方故事留待核实。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: as commonpleas now to allus pueblows and bunkum as Nelson his trifulgurayous pillar
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 都柏林萨克维尔街纳尔逊纪念柱可见馆藏街景。commonpleas 又碰民事法庭名，pueblows 近西语 pueblo，bunkum 是空话；trifulgurayous 带三数与闪光。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Beerman's bluff was what begun it, Old Knoll and his borrowing
fw-iii1-421-01.text: Gordon 听见公园山丘及开篇 knock 声。草稿 barrowing 带土丘或手车声，刊文与底本作 borrowing，中文取借债并把丘留在人名里。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: the liliens of the veldt, Nancy Nickies and Folletta Lajambe
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 草稿 lilies 给出百合，刊文 liliens 可在草原语境听成 lions。两人名依原形音译，Lajambe 兼见法语腿字 jambe。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Then mem and hem and the jaquejack.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: mem、hem 扭曲 me、him 一类代词。雅克与杰克挤成一名，可分别唤起 James、John。三项顺列，谁对应谁仍无定指。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Wucherer and righting his name for him
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 德语 Wucherer 指放高利贷者，大小写也容它像姓名。righting 与 writing 同音，故译「写正」，保两读；谁教谁写名，句中未指实。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: after laying out his litterery bed, for two days she kept squealing down for noisy priors
fw-iii1-421-01.text: litterery 连文字、散乱与一窝幼崽，bed 因而又像产床。Gordon 在 priors 里听见接生钳 pliers，字面仍留院长；分词 laying 的施事从略。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: her jameymock farceson in Shemish
fw-iii1-421-01.text: Gordon 听见 James Macpherson。1762 年《Fingal》扉页称译自盖尔语。farce 和 son 仍在拼词内；Shemish 把谢姆写成一门话，也可牵闪族语。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: a mouther of the incas with a garcielasso
fw-iii1-421-01.text: mouther 在 mother 上添嘴。1605 年《La Florida del Inca》扉页见 Garcilasso 与印加自称，可证声形所近；此段的「印加口妈」另保口述色彩。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: huw Ananymus pinched her tights
fw-iii1-421-01.text: huw 近 how。Ananymus 外形像人名，又近 anonymous。tights 既可指紧身袜，也贴绷紧感。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: the Balt with the markshaire parawag and his loyal divorces, when he feraxiously shed ovas in Alemaney
fw-iii1-421-01.text: Balt 可见波罗的海；markshaire 留标记与头发，parawag 挨近坏小子。loyal 与 divorces 互扯，ovas 留生卵。Alemaney 可听 Alemania，中文暂按拟名。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: tse tse, all the tell of the tud with the bourighevisien backclack
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 啧声在前，舌响收尾。tud 可碰 Tudor；bourighevisien 可挤进 bourgeois 与 Bolshevism 一类政治音，正文保叠音。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: the cribibber like an ambitrickster, aspiring like the decan's
fw-iii1-421-01.text: crib 可指抄袭，bibber 是饮者。Gordon 又听 crybaby。ambitrickster 把两手灵巧转成耍诈，aspiring 同时往吸气和求升伸展。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: fast aslooped in the intrance to his polthronechair with his sixth finger between his catseye and the index
fw-iii1-421-01.text: aslooped 留熟睡和套圈，intrance 近入口和恍惚，polthronechair 把懦夫 poltroon 塞上宝椅。Gordon 试读第六指为笔；猫眼可作弹珠，正文保留异象。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: his pillgrimace of Childe Horrid
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 拜伦题名 Childe Harold’s Pilgrimage 与 Horrid、grimace 照面。第15层作 Child，刊文回到 Childe；中文让哈罗德和恶童同现。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: engrossing to his ganderpan what the idioglossary he invented under hicks hyssop
fw-iii1-421-01.text: engrossing 有誊清义，ganderpan 可兼鹅笔与鹅脑袋，idioglossary 拼私语和词汇表。hyssop 留植物与仪式声影。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Hock! Ickick gav him that toock, imitator!
fw-iii1-421-01.text: Gordon 把此处还原为「那也是我给他的」，接转述与抄袭争执。稿层保留 gave，刊文转 gav；Ickick 也能听见德语 ich 与踢击。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: theck latter to blame
fw-iii1-421-01.text: latter 把责任甩给后一位。Gordon 在 theck 听见 HCE 的 hec 声形；中文先留推诿口吻，把 HCE 声影记在本注。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Does he drink because I am sorely there shall be no more Kates and Nells.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 问句口吻却收句点；sorely 和后面否定直接相撞。中文保留喝酒、我愁苦与两名消失，不把三者关系完全缝合。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: It was given meeck, thank the Bench, to assist at the whole thing byck special chancery licence.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: Bench 指审判席，Gordon 提出 King’s Bench。chancery 是另一套衡平庭称谓。肖恩称获许可，在场见证；meeck／byck 咬着 k 音，也夹 meek 的低姿态。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Shem Skrivenitch
fw-iii1-421-01.text: Skrivenitch 近 scrivener，又拖出 itch。把名字译作「斯克里文痒」，同接文书工作与下文发痒。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: cutting my prhose to please his phrase, bogorror, I declare I get the jawache!
fw-iii1-421-01.text: prhose 把 prose 和裤袜 hose 缝在一起，phrase 回应文句和剪裁。bogorror 稍似舞台爱尔兰英语感叹，又可听 horror；jawache 伤在说话的下巴。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Be me punting his reflection he'd begin his beogrefright in muddyass ribalds.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: punting 可牵 pun 或推拨动作。beogrefright 像变形的 biography，兼巨怪惊相。Gordon 据 McHugh 提醒末尾可听 in medias res，字面另留泥、粗话与从半截开讲。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Digteter! Grundtsagar! Swop beef!
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 三声连喊。Digteter 可听 dictator，另似丹麦语诗人词形 digter；Grundtsagar 留重音和地底声影。Swop beef 可换牛肉，又可交换怨言。具体北欧语拆法待核。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: that eggschicker, with the smell of old woman off him, to suck nothing of his switchedupes
fw-iii1-421-01.text: egg 与鸡声并出，suck 将顺带略去某事的套语改作吸吮。Gordon 另列醉汉与脏话线索；中文保留吸蛋、气味及掉包音，词源未定。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: M.D. made his ante mortem for him.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: ante mortem 是死前，替换常见的 post mortem，尸检倒排到死前。Gordon 又听 auntie death，中文保留倒序。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: grey at three, like sygnus the swan, when he made his boo to the public
fw-iii1-421-01.text: sygnus 近 Cygnus；灰既可指天鹅与衰老。boo 可作喝倒彩声，也从向公众鞠躬、第一次亮相扭来，故译登台一嘘。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: barnacled up to the eyes when he repented after seven
fw-iii1-421-01.text: barnacles 字面为藤壶，也作眼镜俚称。中文让贝壳黏到眼珠，同时带出童年眼镜；after seven 保留年龄句接续。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: The alum that winters on his top is the stale of the staun that will soar when he stambles
fw-iii1-421-01.text: alum 有明矾义，也似 elm，接 staun 中的 stone／Shaun。winters 使头发、白霜和粉末同现；stale 译陈屑，具体所指仍待核。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: that hag of the coombe rapes the pad off his lock
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 可按山谷老妇强扯鬓发处的垫片理解；Gordon 又以都柏林 Coombe 与 Lock Hospital 并读。lock 保头发或锁之影，动作不扩写成确定事件。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: the whooping laugh at the age of the loss of reason the whopping first time he prediseased me
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 百日咳 whooping cough 改成大笑，whopping 再撞前音。age of reason 变失智之龄；prediseased 叠先染病与 predeceased 先死两层。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: middayevil down to his vegetable soul. Never mind his falls feet and his tanbark complexion.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: middayevil 近 medieval，也露正午魔鬼；soul 与脚底 sole 同音。falls feet 可兼摔脚与假脚，Gordon 还听见 false teeth。tanbark 为鞣皮树皮，兼肤色与树身。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: forbidden tomate and was warmed off the ricecourse of marrimoney, under the Helpless Corpses Enactment
fw-iii1-421-01.text: tomate 将交配与番茄相叠；warmed off 与 warned off 相近，米道揉婚礼撒米、赛道和求助之路。Gordon 对照《哥林多前书》7.9 的婚与火，也读作排斥婚配的伪法令。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: the saint kicked him whereby the sum taken Berkeley showed the reason genrously
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 踹踢与算账硬连。Berkeley 可指批评流数论证的乔治·巴克莱；《分析家》第35节嘲称消逝的量成了幽灵。这里只能提出数学声影；圣徒身份与算式均未坐实。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Negas, negasti—negertop, negertoe, negertoby, negrunter!
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 前二词用拉丁 nego 的现在与缩略完成形，译「你否认，你否认过」。后四声同起，含英语种族辱称声影。Gordon 将 negertoe 联系带辱称的数拍儿歌。中文留头、趾和四拍拟声，辱称背景记在此注。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: pusched out of Thingamuddy's school by Miss Garterd, for itching
fw-iii1-421-01.text: pusched 留推出，也碰 Putsch。Gordon 参照慕尼黑啤酒馆政变；历史文献只证该事件。丁嘎泥留随口代名与泥，Garterd 也近吊袜带；逐出缘由仍是痒。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: caught the europicolas and went into the society of jewses.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: caught 带染病口吻，europicolas 露欧洲声，病名未定。jewses 同时招来 Jews 与 Society of Jesus 的相近音；用「犹耶会」保混成和指斥口气。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: With Bro Cahlls and Fran Czeschs and Bruda Pszths and Brat Slavos.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 四项跨页，不漏后两名。Bro、Bruda、Brat 近兄弟称谓，Fran 可听修会称呼或人名，Czeschs、Slavos 可唤民族名；整组不落实为真实会众。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: One temp when he foiled to be killed
fw-iii1-421-01.text: temp 近 time，foiled 折入 failed。to be killed 仍是未能遇死，谁动手、是否求死都没有说实。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: his bilingual head intentionally through the Ikish Tames
fw-iii1-421-01.text: Gordon 并读 The Irish Times、Thames 与英语排犹绰号。正文以报名字形为主，保留头伸穿的动作；原句没有电车或玻璃。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: join the clericy as a demonican skyterrier
fw-iii1-421-01.text: demonican 把 demon 推入 Dominican；skyterrier 把 Skye terrier 转作天梗犬，也留入会和入天的声音。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Throwing dust in the eyes of the Hooley Fermers!
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 扬尘进眼兼欺人套语。Hooley 可以是姓氏，也似喧闹聚会，Fermers 近 farmers；中文暂把前部当作拟名。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: avowdeed as he ought to be vitandist.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: avowdeed 同时挨近 avowed、deed、dead。第15层 vitandust，刊文 vitandist；旧法典第2258条区分应避与容忍的绝罚者，小说变音不能认成正式判词。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: For onced I squeaked by twyst I'll squelch him.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: squeaked by 可指险险混过，也保细声；squelch 反手压声。onced、twyst 形成一回两回，Gordon 另听 I’ll 的三画形，正文主要保吱声与压声。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: on his solo to pick up Galen
fw-iii1-421-01.text: solo 可独行，也可独唱。pick up Galen 像接人，又带学医或拿读物的语域；不据此安排他进某间医馆。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Asbestopoulos! Inkupot! He has encaust in the blood.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: Asbestopoulos 擦过石棉与希腊姓尾，Inkupot 可听墨壶。encaust 可联系墨、烧入色料与刻薄；中文用焦墨承血液。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Shim! I have the outmost contempt for. Prost bitten! Conshy!
fw-iii1-421-01.text: for 后对象空着，前置的 Shim 顶出谢姆音。Prost bitten 可听 frostbitten。Conshy 可能讥用 conscientious objector 的简称，不作乔伊斯本人兵役史的证明。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Tiberia is waiting on you, arestocrank!
fw-iii1-421-01.text: Tiberia 可同时靠近 Tiberius 与 Siberia；arestocrank 叠逮捕、贵族与怪脾气。Gordon 听作放逐讥语，仍非具体历史案。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Chaka a seagull ticket at Gattabuia and Gabbiano's!
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 单程票 single 与 seagull 嘎碰，Gordon 并提契诃夫戏名和 Cheka。意语店名两头各是牢狱、海鸥；「单鸥票」留剧票与放逐并叠。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Go o'er the sea, haythen, from me and leave your libber to TCD.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: haythen 近 heathen，libber 可听 liver；转头接上菜、填食，肝脏由此入译。1939 网本分写 T C D，章稿照底本连写。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Your puddin is cooked! You're served, cram ye!
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 拿布丁改煮熟的鹅一类完蛋套话。served 可上菜，也可送达文书或指活该；cram 是硬塞，接肝脏也可想填鹅。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Fatefully yaourth . . . Ex. Ex. Ex. Ex.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 敬辞由 faithfully 歪作 fatefully，your(s) 也走音。Ex. 四次，既可听书信尾的吻声 X，也牵驱逐或成为前任、故去；正文保字形与次数。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: thrice truthful teller, Shaun of grace?
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 三个 th／t 起头，郑重里有催逼；grace 续接 gracious 和求恩话，也给后面的 Shaun O’ 预备名字声。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Vouchsafe to say. You will now, goodness, won't you? Why?
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 问者欲讨准话。goodness 可是呼语，也像一声「我的天」，译文暂作央求。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: For his root language, if you ask me whys
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 肖恩把敌意归到谢姆说话的根。结城英雄与 Gordon 都联系维柯的原初语言；译作「根语」，保 root 的词根义和下一串变音。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: blessed himself devotionally like a crawsbomb, making act of oblivion
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 十字祝祷走作十字炮。Gordon 又听见十字弩；act of oblivion 可同宗教礼句并读，也像宣布遗忘或赦免。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: footinmouther! (what the thickuns else?)
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 涉口误套语 put one’s foot in one’s mouth，也能听口蹄病的倒装。第15层把这声塞进肖恩引语，刊文挪至动作之后。是谁骂、骂的是谁，仍可两读。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: picksticked into his lettruce invrention
fw-iii1-421-01.text: thickuns 和 picksticked 可能分别擦过 Dickens、Pickwick。pick、stick 保挑和插，lettruce 又像 letter 和 lettuce；invrention 把发明念岔。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Thor's for yo!
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 紧接一口长词，直呼雷神 Thor。稿层作 you，刊文缩 yo；中文收成一响。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: The hundredlettered name again, last word of perfect language.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 听众仍称百字名，译文保存称呼。本底本去行末连字符后有101个英文字母；第15层答话称 lost word，刊文作 last word。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: strong Shaun O', we foresupposed. How?
fw-iii1-421-01.text: suppose 后添 foresuppose，像抢先料定。Shaun O’ 只拖出姓氏前缀，也可回听 Shaun of grace；不替原文补上姓。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Peax! Peax! Shaun replied in vealar penultimatum.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: Peax 可读 peace，又挨近 peas；vealar 拼小牛肉与软腭音。penultimatum 同时是倒数第二与最后通牒。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: pebils before Sweeney's
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 把箴语的珍珠和猪改成石砾与 Sweeney 人家；pebils 又转出豌豆与石子之声。1939 网本作 Sweenys，底本保所有格。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: from his treestem sucker cane. Mildbut likesome!
fw-iii1-421-01.text: sucker 承吸饮，也可指植物萌蘖；cane 兼手杖和茎秆，Gordon 又听见 sugar cane。两声短评判断酒淡、仍合口。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: the four waves till tibbes grey eves and the rests asleep.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 灰暮、睡去与 rest 相牵。Gordon 在 tibbes 听见家猫，在灰暮又听见墓地。四道浪留数，未指定四条地理水域。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: No one in his seven senses could as I have before said, only you missed my drift, for it's being incendiary.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: could 承上问能否接近那种语言，到此省略动作。seven 夸足常用理智套语，missed my drift 既未领会也接四浪漂流，incendiary 既能纵火也能煽动。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: the silbils and wholly words I can show you in my Kingdom of Heaven.
fw-iii1-421-01.text: silbils 从 syllables 拐到女预言者 Sibyls，wholly 同音 holy。整词与圣词同时上场；在天国亮出词语，是肖恩自己的抄袭指控。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: The lowquacity of him! With his threestar monothong!
fw-iii1-421-01.text: loquacity 拼入 low，话多却话低。monothong 扭 monophthong 的单元音，也可听一神之声；三星可唤酒标，与先前饮酒相接。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: Thaw! The last word in stolentelling! And what's more rightdown lowbrown schisthematic robblemint!
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 化冻回应 Frost!。stolentelling 把 storytelling 换成偷讲；lowbrown 附低俗与褐色，schisthematic 可听教裂，robblemint 合 rob、rabble、mint，铺成群伙偷铸。

fw-iii1-421-01.lemma: As he was rising
fw-iii1-421-01.text: 下一行 my lather 仍接 rising。Gordon 听见起泡、兴奋，还联到竖梯。前段以「撩起」收住，宾语由后段续上。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: Shemese
fw-iii1-425-01.text: Shem 与 -ese 拼成话名，后面有 Siamanish。Gordon 指出 me shur 近 my shirt，Shemese 又像 chemise；中文用「谢姆话／衫」透出衣物声。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: Outragedy of poetscalds
fw-iii1-425-01.text: outrage 与 tragedy 同响，poetscalds 可并听诗匠 skald、烫灼 scald，Gordon 又联邮片 postcards。下句书信喜剧接续。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: pibrook
fw-iii1-425-01.text: pibrook 近苏格兰风笛乐 pibroch，词典可核曲义。乔伊斯又在末尾露 brook，风笛声顺溪流爬。风笛也可牵上文 keelrow 的舞曲联想。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: Sireland
fw-iii1-425-01.text: Sireland 合 sire 与 Ireland，父辈、故土在「唤你」里同声。Siren 的声音可另存，暂不令海妖进正文。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: Samoanesia
fw-iii1-425-01.text: Gordon 将 Samoa、Polynesia 与 amnesia 并读。接饮食、草席与不会相忘的声明，故译「萨摩失忆尼西亚」，地理位置仍是小说拟境。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: foggy dews
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 雾露给桶箍镶上钻光。爱尔兰传统音乐档案所收 The Foggy Dew 可供题名对读；原句照样是露珠，未能据此指定歌本。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: my lather. Like you. And as I was plucking his goosybone. Like yea.
fw-iii1-425-01.text: lather 可指皂沫或激动。Gordon 又把 plucking his goosybone 听作拉腿作弄；鹅骨也可接鹅管笔。译文留两人相反方向的动作。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: He store the tale of me shur. Like yup.
fw-iii1-425-01.text: store 与 stole 声近，存下与偷走叠合。shur 近 sure，也可同 me 连念作 my shirt；中文留断续应声。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: well letterread in yourshelves
fw-iii1-425-01.text: well-read、letter 与书架拼合，yourselves 又翻成自己的架。Gordon 还听见邮局收信格及商号信笺抬头。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: the Shamous Shamonous, Limited
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 拟商号含谢姆、Shamus 和 sham 声。Limited 保留公司称谓，也压低夸辞；具体商号没有坐实。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: could use worse of yourself
fw-iii1-425-01.text: Gordon 听见 use words by yourself。译文留反向比较与自己动笔的催问，语气照原文绕行。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: Undoubtedly but that is show
fw-iii1-425-01.text: show 可听 so，又碰上显摆和表演，故先认当然再说摆样子。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: the muttermelk of his blood donor beginning to work
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 乳与血在一句中错接。Gordon 并读输血、同母和上页饮酒见效；供血者身份留白。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: innocent of disseminating the foul emanation, it would be a fall day I could not, sole
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 否认散出恶臭也像否认传流言。fall day 暗带跌落，sole 可听独自或对听者的称呼。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: you can keep your space
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 听众叫他肯花时间，肖恩回你只管守住地盘。Gordon 由此联系谢姆与肖恩的时间／空间对照。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: by the power of blurry wards I am loyable to do it (I am convicted of it!)
fw-iii1-425-01.text: wards 近 words，又可作护卫，loyable 可在 loyal 与 liable 之间听。convicted 把确信拖进定罪语域。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: bet ye fippence off me boot allowance!
fw-iii1-425-01.text: fippence 是口语 fivepence，押注从靴津出。Gordon 对照265页边栏的赌钱口吻。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: the allergrossest transfusiasm
fw-iii1-425-01.text: aller- 递上最高级口气，gross 又大又粗；transfusion 与 enthusiasm 合为输血热兴。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: soroquise the Siamanish better than most
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 第15层 soloquise，刊文 soroquise。可听自语或代声。Siamanish 兼暹罗语声与谢姆声，故译暹姆。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: an openear secret
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 两词构成公开秘密的套话，词缝又露耳朵；肖恩公开的是口述才具。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: extremely ingenuous at the clerking even with my badily left
fw-iii1-425-01.text: ingenuous 作率真，与前面 ingenious 才智近形。笨左手照样能办文书，是肖恩自己的夸语。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: arrah go braz, I'd pinsel it with immenuensoes
fw-iii1-425-01.text: go braz 可比爱尔兰语 go brách，仍是拟音。pinsel 近 pencil，也可听画笔。immenuensoes 混记文书助手与暗示语。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: perorate a chickerow of beans for the price of two maricles
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 长篇讲说却朝豆去。Gordon 并读鹰嘴豆、串珠和两声圣母祷，maricles 将 Mary 声塞进 miracles。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: my trifolium librotto, the authordux Book of Lief
fw-iii1-425-01.text: trifolium 可见三叶、三页，librotto 缝书和唱本。authordux 并作者与正统，Lief 挨 life 并回听利菲河名。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: if given to daylight, (I hold a most incredible faith about it)
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 作品未见天日，他先宣称相信得难以相信。括号保信与不信拧在一处。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: my soamheis brother, Gaoy Fecks
fw-iii1-425-01.text: soamheis 可牵同胞和暹罗双生。拟名可听 Guy Fawkes；Gordon 另读偷窃，历史姓名相近只供比对。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: in audible black and prink.
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 分写可读有声，连作 inaudible 又可听无声。prink 混粉色、印字和墨水，保写字、说话互拗。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: Acomedy of letters!
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 可听一场书信喜剧，连写又似 academy。letters 在信件、字母、文墨之间换位。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: I have them all, tame, deep and harried, in my mine's I.
fw-iii1-425-01.text: have 把前面的诗、信一把揽下。tame 和 harried 并排，安驯与受扰互拧。mine’s I 改造 mind’s eye，把内眼转成我的矿藏。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: cut my throat with my tongue tonight
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 口头失言本可自害；小说让舌头真去割自己的喉咙，接上下面改拿铅笔。willhap 兼将然和或然，第15层移这词到后半句。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: I will be ormuzd moved to take potlood
fw-iii1-425-01.text: Ormazd 是阿胡拉·马兹达名形；ormuzd moved 也可听 almost moved。potlood 确为荷兰语铅笔，Gordon 又联 take potluck；中文用「铅签赌一把」补两读。草稿另有 in hand。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: introvent it Paatryk just like a work of merit
fw-iii1-425-01.text: introvent 叠 introduce、invent，也可触内外转向。Paatryk 近 Patrick；Gordon 联圣帕特里克引入文字的说法。这里用作肖恩自夸，不能当爱尔兰文字史。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: mark my words and append to my mark twang
fw-iii1-425-01.text: mark 可叫听者记住，也可指落款；twang 是说话鼻音或拨弦响。Gordon 另听 Mark Twain。这里保同一声兼记字、签名与听腔。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: your pucktricker's ops for you, broather brooher
fw-iii1-425-01.text: pucktricker 叠捣鬼、Puck 与 Patrick 的近音，ops可听眼目；broather、brooher 连叫两声变形的 brother。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: only for, as a papst
fw-iii1-425-01.text: only for 领起末尾 I would never，翻回前面的「我会」。先许著书，到这一处才拿身份辞谢费力。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: as a papst and an immature and a nayophight and a spaciaman spaciosum and a hundred and eleven other things
fw-iii1-425-01.text: papst 有教宗音，又可听乳食；nayophight 变体贴 neophyte、nay 与 fight。spaciaman spaciosum 装成拉丁空阔人。最后明说另有一百一十一项。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: a chap too fly and hairyman for to infradig the like of that ultravirulence
fw-iii1-425-01.text: fly 可机灵，也闪苍蝇声；hairyman 则毛茸。infradig 近 infra dignitatem，有失身份；ultravirulence 把烈毒推到极端。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: on my piop and oath by the awe of Shaun (and that's a howl of a name!)
fw-iii1-425-01.text: piop 近 pipe；425／426页断在烟斗与誓之间。awe、Shaun、howl 让誓言自己嚎起来，名字由赞叹转作出声。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: I will commission to the flames any incendiarist whosoever or ahriman howsoclever
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 先骂纵火，自己却要把人交给火，commission 仍如发差遣令。阿赫里曼与上页奥尔穆兹德成对；资料核名形和某一传统中的相对关系。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: set ever annyma roner moother of mine on fire
fw-iii1-425-01.text: Gordon 把拟名和旧歌 Little Annie Rooney、安娜·利维娅相联，兼听 set the Thames on fire 的夸辞。乐谱可核歌名，不能单凭谱断定指涉。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: Rock me julie but I will soho!
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 第15层以逗号叫朱莉，刊文连成一口。Krehbiel 采谱写把人当婴儿摇，和河上的摇荡、下句哭声接上。soho 保招呼或喊声，其他所指待核。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: crickcrackcruck of his threelungged squool
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 三响齐发，像断裂，也像压不住的哭。threelungged 带三重肺力，squool 揉尖叫、风啸。Gordon 另听船桶擦撞及三腿凳；声源未定。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: from which grief had usupped every smile
fw-iii1-425-01.text: usupped 像 usurped，又让 sup 嘬饮笑意。Gordon 联歌曲 Don’t Blame the Mother，本批未独立核歌谱，先保词面悲与笑。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: big hottempered husky fusky krenfy strenfy pugiliser
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 一连串夸拳汉火性、声粗和体壮，却用儿语式尾音成串变声。中文保粗气、劲壮复沓。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: broke down on the mooherhead, getting quite jerry over her
fw-iii1-425-01.text: mooherhead 推进母亲／母性和牛哞，Gordon 也听 mooring head 系泊处。broke down 可能同时是情绪崩溃与物件碰倒；jerry 暂按失态试读。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: the love of the tearsilver that he twined through her hair
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 泪和银丝从词内缠到发上。Gordon 又读泪入利菲成银纹。译文把泪线绕回母亲头发，保主动者是他。第15层另以逗号分开 hair 和 for。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: with a heart like Montgomery's in his showchest and harvey loads of feeling in him
fw-iii1-425-01.text: showchest 既敞胸给人看，也像陈列箱。harvey loads 近 heavy loads；心血语境亦可听威廉·哈维。蒙哥马利是谁仍不定。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: as innocent and undesignful as the freshfallen calef
fw-iii1-425-01.text: freshfallen 像刚落地，calef 见 calf，又可听 caliph。Gordon 旁提哈里发制倾覆；这里先保新生的纯真，中文把牛犊与拟称并置。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: dished allarmes away and laughed it off with a wipe at his pudgies and a gulp apologetic
fw-iii1-425-01.text: dish 保盘与端走，allarmes 紧接全数警报。pudgies 词形带胖；Gordon 据动作试作脸颊。吞咽把道歉截成一咕。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: healing his tare be the smeyle of his oye, oogling around
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 变音落在 tear、by、smile、eye。tare 又像扯开处，泪可并伤口；oogling 两圆眼作看。第15层 aroond，刊文 around。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: Him belly no belong sollow mole pigeon. Ally bully. Fu Li's gulpa.
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 短句仿洋泾浜英语，pigeon 可听 pidgin；sollow 可夹 swallow、sorrow。Gordon 把 Fu Li 当拟名。末声牵 gulp 与 culpa，中文留咕咽和认错的声影。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: the dumpest of earnest orthough him jawr war hoo hleepy hor halk urthing hurther
fw-iii1-425-01.text: dumpest 既深沉也沮丧。orthough 近 although 并透正统音；后半像下巴困沉，连说话都漏声。中文保口齿黏结。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: Moe like that only he stopped short in looking up up upfrom his tide shackled wrists
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 第15层将 Moe 独立成句，刊文随 like that 接续。Gordon 听如 more，也联系睡声。up 三次递高，起点仍是潮锁住的双腕，不抹成人离水站立。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: through the ghost of an ocean's, the wieds of pansiful heathvens of joepeter's gaseytotum
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 第15层在 ocean 后接 upon，刊文及底本留 ocean’s 后逗号。wieds 近海藻，heathvens 夹异教人与天，joepeter 近 Jupiter，gaseytotum 表层可听气团和旋转物。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: as they are telling not but were and will be, all told, scruting foreback into the fargoneahead
fw-iii1-425-01.text: tell 兼说与计数，句中保无言又总括的矛盾。foreback、fargoneahead 把前、后、已逝和将来来回折叠。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: years tropical, ecclesiastic, civil or sidereal
fw-iii1-425-01.text: tropical year 译回归年，按季节循环计；sidereal year 参恒星方向。另两项是教会与民用时间。四项列举服务摸年龄，不能据此推准确岁数。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: the sirious pointstand of Charley's Wain
fw-iii1-425-01.text: Charley’s Wain 是北斗的旧称。斗口两星指北极星；sirious 可听 serious，也掠 Sirius 声。两处星名声影并存，不能因此说北斗指天狼星。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: the spheres sledding along the lacteal and the mansions of the blest turning on old times
fw-iii1-425-01.text: lacteal 让天球沿乳白银河滑过。前面的 betune 又含 between／tune，连天球和声。《约翰福音》14.2 的父家居所有近影；old times 照旧节拍转。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: as erewhile had he craved of thus
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 从天球括语转回前面的渴求，再接梦晕套颈。第15层在括语后添逗号，底本让动势顺接。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: the dreamskhwindel necklassoed him
fw-iii1-425-01.text: dream、晕眩与套索揉作一件事，颈项接上文潮锁双腕。Gordon 兼听水旋，译文用「梦旋晕」留转动。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: his thumbs fell into his fists and, lusosing the harmonical balance of his ballbearing extremities
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 拇指先落入拳，再失肢端平衡。ballbearing 连滚珠轴承与掌足肉球，harmonical 回扣天球和声。Gordon 并提拉丁 lusus 的游戏音。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: by the holy kettle, like a flask of lightning over he careened
fw-iii1-425-01.text: holy kettle 像临口起誓，flask 把闪电盛进瓶。Gordon 在仰星情境想到射手座壶形，译文保器物和翻侧，星座指认留疑。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: O the sons of the fathers!
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 父子呼声夹在翻船般转身之间；sons 在星夜又可听作 suns。中文保儿子，日星音影记在此。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: by the mightyfine weight of his barrel
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 重量才是翻侧的直接语因，his barrel 一面是他的桶，一面容肖恩和桶同形。正文不把它坐实为乘客借桶脱身。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: all that prevented the happering of who if not the asterisks betwink themselves shall ever?
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 问句次序刻意拧结；happering 像事情发生，又拖进阻绊。asterisks 可是星号也像群星，twink 回响眨眼。第15层多处逗号，底本连放。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: as the wisest postlude course he could playact, collaspsed in ensemble
fw-iii1-425-01.text: postlude、playact、ensemble 先构成演出词场，又把群奏塞进全身一垮。第15层较短，作 postlude he could playact、collapsed；正文保现读。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: rolled buoyantly backwards in less than a twinkling via Rattigan's corner out of farther earshot
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 浮着向后滚，转眼超出耳界，读法可与潮水转向相通。Rattigan’s corner 以拟地名处理，实际街角未落实。第15层作 further。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: slipashod motion, surefoot, sorefoot, slickfoot, slackfoot
fw-iii1-425-01.text: slipashod 混趿鞋与马虎，四个 foot 短拍跨页，先稳而后疼、滑、松。译文保一声一脚。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: linkman laizurely, lampman loungey
fw-iii1-425-01.text: linkman 在此可读执火把照路，接 lampman 提灯；两副懒散步态照应懒脚。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: Killesther's lapes and falls
fw-iii1-425-01.text: lapes 可听 leaps，和 falls 同时是跳跌与水势。Gordon 联两位埃丝特，中文保基勒斯特拟地名，地点与指涉均待核。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: with corks, staves and treeleaves and more bubbles to his keelrow
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 软木、桶板和叶子沿水面漂，keelrow 指向龙骨下水痕，也可听 row 的划水。第15层多一个 and 且在 keelrow 后顿住。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: the town cow cries behind the times in the direction of Mac Auliffe's, the crucethouse, Open the Door Softly
fw-iii1-425-01.text: cow cries 可听乡牛长叫，behind the times 既落后也错拍。Gordon 联 crucethouse 与十字形教堂；大写短句也可当歌名线索。本批只译命令句，具体场所仍未证实。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: in a dip of the downs (uila!)
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 萨摩亚语 uila 指闪电，新西兰相关拼写指南以它为例。夹在低洼和消失之间，译文留拟音并补一声闪。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: spoorlessly disappaled and vanesshed
fw-iii1-425-01.text: spoorlessly 无足迹；另两词扭曲消失。Gordon 把 vanesshed 接 Vanessa，下一行星光再响 Stella；传记只核别名。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: like a popo down a papa, from circular circulatio. Ah, mean!
fw-iii1-425-01.text: popo／papa 可听幼儿语，也容教皇、便器或污物坠落。Gordon 联冲旋。circular 与 circulatio 重说回环，Ah, mean 近 Amen，又让 mean 冒头。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: Gaogaogaone! Tapaa!
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 离去声断续，Tapaa 可听 ta-ta 或水上一拍。Gordon 另联萨摩亚语烟草；确切词根留疑。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: And the stellas were shinings.
fw-iii1-425-01.text: stellas 既如群星，也回听上一段 vanesshed 对出的 Stella。传记核埃丝特·约翰逊之别名。shinings 多一重尾音，中文用「亮着呢」让星光延续。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: the earthnight strewed aromatose.
fw-iii1-425-01.text: earthnight 是地上夜色，也容 Gordon 所读夜土。aromatose 拼香气与迷醉状态，下一句 reek 仍可刺鼻。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: His pibrook creppt mong the donkness.
fw-iii1-425-01.text: creppt 与 mong 吞错声，donkness 在 darkness 中夹驴音。风笛声缓爬，也可听到一串破响。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: A reek was waft on the luftstream.
fw-iii1-425-01.text: reek 可是烟气、浓气味，既能臭也能承下一句香。luftstream 是空气流的混辞，waft 仍是随风漂。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: He was ours, all fragrance. And we were his for a lifetime.
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 他归咱，咱归他。两次所有格反转，末尾一生时长只在后句落下。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: O dulcid dreamings languidous! Taboccoo!
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 甜与倦叠成梦声，Taboccoo 念岔 tobacco；中文留末词拟音并补烟。第15层在梦与倦之间顿了一下。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: It was sharming! But sharmeng!
fw-iii1-425-01.text: charming 沾 sham 的假，次句同词变口。第15层有 scharmeng，刊文和底本 sharmeng。中文让第二声再糊一点。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: the lamp went out as it couldn't glow on burning, yep, the lmp wnt out for it couldn't stay alight.
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 熄灯重复一遍，lmp、wnt 抽元音，像灯火和声音同时收缩。译文第二遍以「丁」薄化灯字，压短节拍。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: how dire do we thee hours when thylike fades!
fw-iii1-425-01.text: thy likeness 的影貌黯下去，又可听 thy light。dire 时辰承熄灯，括号插说者的急叹。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: mine bruder, able Shaun, with a twhisking of the robe
fw-iii1-425-01.text: bruder 保兄弟称谓，able 可听 Abel；Gordon 将抖袍对读弥尔顿《利西达斯》诗尾。第15层 twhisting，底本 twhisking。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: beyond cods' cradle and porpoise plain, from carnal relations undfamiliar faces
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 鳕鱼的摇篮与江豚的平原都是以海物作海域名字，后半再离骨肉和半熟半生的面孔。第15层把离亲放在水路之前，并写 and familiar。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: the inds of Tuskland where the oliphants scrum till the ousts of Amiracles where the toll stories grow proudest
fw-iii1-425-01.text: Tuskland 有长牙国，inds 近 Indies；Amiracles 合 America 与 miracle，toll stories 又像 tall stories 和楼层。故用牙国、阿美奇迹与通天大话，地点保持拟名。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: manomano and myriamilia even to mulimuli
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 三个数语般的词层层延长。Gordon 用萨摩亚语千与末尾对读。中文保千、万、末的叠声，外语拆分先存推测。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: it is hardly we in the country of the old, Sean Moy, can part you
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 故国与老者之国并叠，Sean Moy 像拟地名，也唤肖恩。句口绕折，仍说难以同他分开。紧随其后的 oleypoe 暂保拟声。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: tootoo too stayer, the graced of gods and pittites and the salus of the wake.
fw-iii1-425-01.text: tootoo too 把太、再和哭腔挤一处。pittites 可听剧院池座观众，salus 能指安康或救护。神、观众同列，使圣徒也像登场人。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: Countenance whose disparition afflictedly fond Fuinn feels.
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 先提脸，再说芬恩感其消失，f 声从 fond 连到 Fuinn、feels。Fuinn 也可撞爱尔兰芬恩和英语文学的 Finn；此处照声音留名。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: Winner of the gamings, primed at the studience, propredicted from the storybouts, the choice of ages wise!
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 连排赞辞，从赛会、学堂到故事预卜。ages wise 又近 ancient eyes，故写历世慧眼。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: Spickspookspokesman of our specturesque silentiousness!
fw-iii1-425-01.text: spick、spook 和 spokesman 三拍相挤。specturesque 把如画揉进鬼影，silentiousness 把长声推向沉默。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: Musha, beminded of us out there in Cockpit, poor twelve o'clock scholars
fw-iii1-425-01.text: Musha 可比爱尔兰语 muise 的叹声。Cockpit 可听斗鸡场，也可能是拟地名。twelve o’clock 回响章首午夜报钟；钟点照译，不定成正午。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: Wisha, becoming back to us way home in Biddyhouse one way or either anywhere we miss your smile.
fw-iii1-425-01.text: Wisha 以叹声续恳求。Biddyhouse 像比迪家，也可因 Biddy 是母鸡名而听成鸡屋。第15层 one way or the other，底本 either。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: Palmwine breadfruit sweetmeat milksoup! Suasusupo! However!
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 酒、果、蜜食、奶汤一口报数。milksoup 又可贴 milksop，软弱人。Gordon 在 supo 听见奶词，正文保整声，不坐实 Suasusupo 的各片。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: the elders luking and marking the jornies, chalkin up drizzle in drizzle out on the four bare mats
fw-iii1-425-01.text: mark、chalk 同带划记，drizzle in／out 使阴雨像一天进出。四空席可听市门、坐席和四方。草稿 chalking，正文留 chalkin。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: how the deepings did it all begin
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 问事情从何处开头，deepings 添下潜声，句面也像 how the deuce 一类惊叹。译文先落实「哪一重深处」。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: scrimmaging through your scruples to collar a hold of an imperfection being committled
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 顾虑中有抱团推挤、拽领擒住的体育词。committled 夹 committed 和 little 声，责难也被缩小。主体仍模糊。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: Mery Loye is saling moonlike.
fw-iii1-425-01.text: Gordon 听出音乐厅艺人 Marie Lloyd，V&A 资料可核其名。saling 像扬帆，又可听歌声远荡；人物仍用拟名。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: Slyly mamourneen's ladymaid at Gladshouse Lodge
fw-iii1-425-01.text: mamourneen 可比爱尔兰语 muirnín 一类亲昵称呼。底本所有格像 Slyly 心肝的侍女；第15层把名字大写并以 is 直说她当侍女。庄园与人物身份未定。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: Turn your coat, strong character, and tarry among us down the vale, yougander, only once more!
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 翻衣可回头，也可像倒戈换袍。yougander 同时叫你公鹅，并带年轻声。咒愿从再待一次转向滚回老家。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: the mosse of prosperousness gather you rolling home
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 滚石不生苔的惯语在祝愿中倒转，滚回家却要聚苔。mosse、prosperousness 叠繁茂和福运。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: the fireplug of filiality reinsure your bunghole!
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 消防栓、孝与续保撞在一处；bunghole 可听木桶塞孔，保留身体笑料的余地。第15层作 bunghole，本文少 g。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: the barleywind behind glow luck to your bathershins!
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 顺风祝词竟吹来麦味，bathershins 明带涉水小腿，也近 widdershins 的逆向声。译文保风向、照运气和胫。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: winding your hobbledehorn, right royal post
fw-iii1-425-01.text: winding 可吹号，hobble 又把步子吹成跛脚。post 是邮差、邮务，也接前文皇家口吻。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: pulse of our slumber, dreambookpage, by the grace of Votre Dame
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 他成了睡中脉搏和梦册书页。Votre Dame 把熟悉的 Notre Dame 改作「您」的圣母。第15层作 dreambookpoge。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: the natural morning of your nocturne blankmerges into the national morning of golden sunup
fw-iii1-425-01.text: natural／national 变一声，黎明从个体夜曲挪到邦国；blankmerges 有白、空及悄合。草稿写 mourning，刊文及底本写 morning，哀声仍贴晨声。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: Don Leary gets his own back from old grog Georges Quartos
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 拟人名 Don Leary 近 Dunleary 港名。地名资料载乔治四世访问后于1821年改 Kingstown，1920年用 Dún Laoghaire。原文让港镇讨回其名，又像人物报复。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: the Jonnyjoys takes the wind from waterloogged Erin's king
fw-iii1-425-01.text: takes the wind 同时是抢上风和令对方泄气；水浸也让 loogged 撞 Waterloo。保船名拟音及埃林王，具体船史与人物留待核。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: you will shiff across the Moylendsea and round up in your own escapology
fw-iii1-425-01.text: shiff 掠 skiff、shift 和 ship，船行兼换位。Moylendsea 牵 Moyle 水名与越海，round up 兜回，escapology 像演出脱逃术。草稿 skiff，刊本 shiff。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: some canonisator's day or other, sack on back, alack!
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 不确定哪天，偏以封圣人命名；sack、back、alack 接连敲拍，邮袋、驼背与哀声余音相叠。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: picture pockets turned knockside out in the rake of the rain for fresh remittances
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 翻空口袋像等钱寄来，picture 又可读其样子如画。rake 带耙刮与雨扫，保雨中等新汇款的形象。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: timus tenant
fw-iii1-425-01.text: 时间租客似听 time；Gordon 又联萨摩亚语雨词及临时任职语。暂译时光佃客，复合词根留疑。

fw-iii1-425-01.lemma: the tussocks grow quickly under your trampthickets and the daisies trip lightly over your battercops.
fw-iii1-425-01.text: trampthickets 合践踏、草丛，还可听 tram tickets。battercops 近受撞的头顶，也可听 buttercups。雏菊跳过头，Gordon 联墓草俗语；译文保轻盈和磕损，不写定死讯。
